column9: Describes qualities that belong to a thing itself and are not on display: 內在美, 內在聯繫, 內在動力. Its counterpart is 外在. It sits before a noun, in writing and discussion; for the inside of a room or box say 裡面.

column3: 之 is a written "of", so this word suits limits of time, distance and range: 三天之内, 一公里之内, 预料之内. It follows the limit it measures. 以内 does the same job and is the plainer choice in speech.
column6: Qǐng zài sān tiān zhīnèi huífù wǒ.
column7: Please reply to me within three days.
column9: 之 is a written "of", so this word suits limits of time, distance and range: 三天之內, 一公里之內, 預料之內. It follows the limit it measures. 以內 does the same job and is the plainer choice in speech.

column3: Most useful in 除了…之外: followed by 还 it means "as well as", followed by 都 it means "all except". Also "beyond a limit": 意料之外 is "unexpected", 国门之外 is beyond the borders. 以外 can replace it.
column4: 除了数学之外，他还喜欢历史。
column5: 除了數學之外，他還喜歡歷史。
column6: Chúle shùxué zhīwài, tā hái xǐhuan lìshǐ.
column7: Besides math, he also likes history.
column9: Most useful in 除了…之外: followed by 還 it means "as well as", followed by 都 it means "all except". Also "beyond a limit": 意料之外 is "unexpected", 國門之外 is beyond the borders. 以外 can replace it.

column3: Usually 在…之下, giving the conditions something happens under: 在大家的帮助之下 is "with everyone's help", 在老师的领导之下 "under the teacher's leadership". Written; for "underneath" something physical, 下面 is natural.
column4: 在大家的帮助之下，他完成了任务。
column5: 在大家的幫助之下，他完成了任務。
column6: Zài dàjiā de bāngzhù zhīxià, tā wánchéng le rènwu.
column7: With everyone's help, he completed the task.
column9: Usually 在…之下, giving the conditions something happens under: 在大家的幫助之下 is "with everyone's help", 在老師的領導之下 "under the teacher's leadership". Written; for "underneath" something physical, 下面 is natural.

column3: Puts someone in the midst of a situation or group, usually 在…之中: 困难之中, 人群之中, 忙碌之中. It is written and a little literary; in plain speech 里 does the job. It does not mean the middle of a physical space.
column4: 他在危险之中保持冷静。
column5: 他在危險之中保持冷靜。
column6: Tā zài wēixiǎn zhīzhōng bǎochí lěngjìng.
column7: He stayed calm in the midst of danger.
column9: Puts someone in the midst of a situation or group, usually 在…之中: 困難之中, 人群之中, 忙碌之中. It is written and a little literary; in plain speech 裡 does the job. It does not mean the middle of a physical space.

column3: It comes after what is counted, to show that it is part of the total: 连我在内, 包括税在内, 费用在内. The group must be named before it. Not for the inside of a room or box, which is 里面.
column4: 连我在内，一共有五个人。
column5: 連我在內，一共有五個人。
column6: Lián wǒ zàinèi, yīgòng yǒu wǔ ge rén.
column7: Counting me, there are five people altogether.
column9: It comes after what is counted, to show that it is part of the total: 連我在內, 包括稅在內, 費用在內. The group must be named before it. Not for the inside of a room or box, which is 裡面.

column3: A verb with no object, about someone being there when something happens: 在场的人 are "those present", 当时在场 "was there at the time". 不在场证明 is an alibi. Its opposite is 不在场.
column4: 事故发生时，他正好在场。
column5: 事故發生時，他正好在場。
column6: Shìgù fāshēng shí, tā zhènghǎo zàichǎng.
column7: He happened to be present when the accident occurred.
column9: A verb with no object, about someone being there when something happens: 在場的人 are "those present", 當時在場 "was there at the time". 不在場證明 is an alibi. Its opposite is 不在場.

column3: A formal comparison for numbers and standards: 低于平均水平, 低于零度. The standard comes after it. Its pair is 高于. In speech use 比…低, or 不到 for "not even reaching" an amount.
column6: Jīntiān de wēndù dīyú língdù.
column7: Today's temperature is below zero.
column9: A formal comparison for numbers and standards: 低於平均水平, 低於零度. The standard comes after it. Its pair is 高於. In speech use 比…低, or 不到 for "not even reaching" an amount.

column3: The written counterpart of 低于, comparing against a standard or number: 高于平均水平, 高于零度. Speech uses 比…高. It compares levels, prices and standards; the math symbol > is 大于.
column4: 这里的房价高于全国平均水平。
column5: 這裡的房價高於全國平均水平。
column6: Zhèlǐ de fángjià gāoyú quánguó píngjūn shuǐpíng.
column7: House prices here are above the national average.
column9: The written counterpart of 低於, comparing against a standard or number: 高於平均水平, 高於零度. Speech uses 比…高. It compares levels, prices and standards; the math symbol > is 大於.

column3: Mostly for numbers and measures, as in math, rules and reports: 大于等于 is "greater than or equal to", and the matching words are 小于 and 等于. For everyday size comparisons use 比…大.
column6: Wǔ dàyú sān.
column7: Five is greater than three.
column9: Mostly for numbers and measures, as in math, rules and reports: 大於等於 is "greater than or equal to", and the matching words are 小於 and 等於. For everyday size comparisons use 比…大.

column3: Two uses: really going around something (地球围绕太阳转) and taking something as the focus (围绕这个问题讨论, 围绕…展开). It takes its object directly, often with 着.
column6: Dìqiú wéirào tàiyáng zhuàn.
column7: The earth goes around the sun.
column9: Two uses: really going around something (地球圍繞太陽轉) and taking something as the focus (圍繞這個問題討論, 圍繞…展開). It takes its object directly, often with 著.

column3: Describes an account, plan or explanation: 详细的介绍, 说得很详细. Before a verb it is an adverb, with or without 地: 详细说明. The opposite is 简单. For "specific" points, 具体 is the usual word.
column6: Qǐng nǐ xiángxì de shuō yīxià.
column7: Please tell me in detail.
column9: Describes an account, plan or explanation: 詳細的介紹, 說得很詳細. Before a verb it is an adverb, with or without 地: 詳細說明. The opposite is 簡單. For "specific" points, 具體 is the usual word.

column3: Careful in paying close attention to details: 仔细看, 仔细检查, 仔细想想. 小心 is care against danger instead, so "be careful on the road" is 小心, while "read it carefully" is 仔细.
column6: Nǐ yào zǐxì jiǎnchá yī biàn.
column7: You must go through it carefully.
column9: Careful in paying close attention to details: 仔細看, 仔細檢查, 仔細想想. 小心 is care against danger instead, so "be careful on the road" is 小心, while "read it carefully" is 仔細.

column3: Two uses. As a manner it is decisive and straight to the point: 他说话很干脆. As an adverb it proposes the blunt shortcut after a problem: 太麻烦了，干脆不去了, "let's just skip it". Often follows a complaint or 反正.
column6: Tài máfan le, gāncuì bié qù le.
column7: It is too much trouble, so let's just not go.
column9: Two uses. As a manner it is decisive and straight to the point: 他說話很乾脆. As an adverb it proposes the blunt shortcut after a problem: 太麻煩了，乾脆不去了, "let's just skip it". Often follows a complaint or 反正.

column3: Said to a guest, 请随意 means "make yourself at home, do as you like". Before a verb it means "freely": 随意选择, 随意坐. Used about a bad habit it means "carelessly": 随意乱扔.
column6: Dàjiā suíyì zuò, bié kèqi.
column7: Sit wherever you like, make yourselves at home.
column9: Said to a guest, 請隨意 means "make yourself at home, do as you like". Before a verb it means "freely": 隨意選擇, 隨意坐. Used about a bad habit it means "carelessly": 隨意亂扔.

column3: Describes attitudes and moods (negative: 消极的态度, 消极情绪) and behavior (passive, inactive: 消极等待). In 消极影响 it is a harmful effect. The opposite is 积极.
column4: 不要用消极的态度面对问题。
column5: 不要用消極的態度面對問題。
column6: Bùyào yòng xiāojí de tàidù miànduì wèntí.
column7: Do not face problems with a negative attitude.
column9: Describes attitudes and moods (negative: 消極的態度, 消極情緒) and behavior (passive, inactive: 消極等待). In 消極影響 it is a harmful effect. The opposite is 積極.

column3: About who has the initiative: 处于被动 is being on the defensive, 很被动 being at a disadvantage. 被动语态 is the grammatical passive voice. The opposite is 主动.
column4: 他在比赛中一直很被动。
column5: 他在比賽中一直很被動。
column6: Tā zài bǐsài zhōng yīzhí hěn bèidòng.
column7: He was on the defensive throughout the match.
column9: About who has the initiative: 處於被動 is being on the defensive, 很被動 being at a disadvantage. 被動語態 is the grammatical passive voice. The opposite is 主動.

column3: Hard in the sense of hardship, for a life, journey or situation that takes effort to bear: 艰难的生活, 艰难地前进. A heavier word than 难; for a hard test question say 难, not 艰难.
column4: 他们度过了一段艰难的日子。
column5: 他們度過了一段艱難的日子。
column6: Tāmen dùguò le yī duàn jiānnán de rìzi.
column7: They went through a difficult time.
column9: Hard in the sense of hardship, for a life, journey or situation that takes effort to bear: 艱難的生活, 艱難地前進. A heavier word than 難; for a hard test question say 難, not 艱難.

column3: Indirect: 间接地 before a verb, 间接影响, 间接经验 for second-hand experience. The opposite is 直接. In this word 间 is read jiàn, the "gap" reading, not jiān "between".
column6: Wǒ shì jiànjiē tīngshuō de.
column7: I only heard it indirectly.
column9: Indirect: 間接地 before a verb, 間接影響, 間接經驗 for second-hand experience. The opposite is 直接. In this word 間 is read jiàn, the "gap" reading, not jiān "between".

column3: Quietly, making no noise so as not to disturb: 悄悄地走, 悄悄地说. 偷偷 is about hiding what you do, not about sound.
column6: Tā qiāoqiāo de zǒuchū le fángjiān.
column7: She quietly left the room.
column9: Quietly, making no noise so as not to disturb: 悄悄地走, 悄悄地說. 偷偷 is about hiding what you do, not about sound.

column3: Secretly, doing something you should not or do not want known: 偷偷地 plus a verb, 偷偷看, 偷偷笑. 悄悄 is about being quiet; 偷偷 is about hiding it. Often playful rather than criminal.
column4: 他偷偷地吃了一块蛋糕。
column5: 他偷偷地吃了一塊蛋糕。
column6: Tā tōutōu de chī le yī kuài dàngāo.
column7: He secretly ate a piece of cake.
column9: Secretly, doing something you should not or do not want known: 偷偷地 plus a verb, 偷偷看, 偷偷笑. 悄悄 is about being quiet; 偷偷 is about hiding it. Often playful rather than criminal.

column3: Always before a verb, with or without 地: 紧紧地抱着, 紧紧握住, 紧紧跟着 "follow closely". Doubled from 紧, it is vivid and a little emphatic, often for hugs, grips and attention.
column6: Háizi jǐnjǐn de bàozhe māma.
column7: The child hugged its mother tightly.
column9: Always before a verb, with or without 地: 緊緊地抱著, 緊緊握住, 緊緊跟著 "follow closely". Doubled from 緊, it is vivid and a little emphatic, often for hugs, grips and attention.

column3: An act of a person that others notice, often surprising or suspicious: 可疑的举动, 奇怪的举动, 一举一动 "every move". 行为 is behavior as a pattern; 动作 is a physical motion, such as a gesture.
column4: 他的举动让大家很吃惊。
column5: 他的舉動讓大家很吃驚。
column6: Tā de jǔdòng ràng dàjiā hěn chījīng.
column7: His behavior surprised everyone.
column9: An act of a person that others notice, often surprising or suspicious: 可疑的舉動, 奇怪的舉動, 一舉一動 "every move". 行為 is behavior as a pattern; 動作 is a physical motion, such as a gesture.

column3: Soft to the touch, and gentle or weak in a person: 心软 "soft-hearted", 腿软 "weak in the legs". The opposite is 硬. It is also the "soft" of 软件, with 硬件 for hardware.
column4: 这张床太软了，我睡不好。
column5: 這張床太軟了，我睡不好。
column6: Zhè zhāng chuáng tài ruǎn le, wǒ shuì bù hǎo.
column7: This bed is too soft, I cannot sleep well.
column9: Soft to the touch, and gentle or weak in a person: 心軟 "soft-hearted", 腿軟 "weak in the legs". The opposite is 硬. It is also the "soft" of 軟件, with 硬件 for hardware.

column3: Hard, stiff: 硬币 is a coin, 硬座 a hard seat on a train, 硬件 hardware. As an adverb it means "stubbornly, by force": 他硬要去 is "he insisted on going". The opposite of 软.
column6: Zhège miànbāo tài yìng le.
column7: This bread is too hard.
column9: Hard, stiff: 硬幣 is a coin, 硬座 a hard seat on a train, 硬件 hardware. As an adverb it means "stubbornly, by force": 他硬要去 is "he insisted on going". The opposite of 軟.

column3: For large surfaces such as roads, land and grass: 平坦的道路, 地势平坦. A table or a sheet of paper is 平, not 平坦. Often follows 又宽又 in descriptions of roads.
column6: Zhè tiáo lù yòu kuān yòu píngtǎn.
column7: This road is wide and level.
column9: For large surfaces such as roads, land and grass: 平坦的道路, 地勢平坦. A table or a sheet of paper is 平, not 平坦. Often follows 又寬又 in descriptions of roads.

column3: Slanted, off the straight: 斜线 is a slash, 斜坡 a slope, 斜着看 to look sideways. As an adjective it follows its subject or an adverb: 有点斜. For a tilted head or a crooked picture speech also uses 歪.
column6: Zhè kē shù yǒudiǎn xié.
column7: This tree leans a little.
column9: Slanted, off the straight: 斜線 is a slash, 斜坡 a slope, 斜著看 to look sideways. As an adjective it follows its subject or an adverb: 有點斜. For a tilted head or a crooked picture speech also uses 歪.

column3: Weak in an abstract thing, such as a base, a defense or will: 薄弱环节 is the weak link, 基础薄弱 a weak foundation, 意志薄弱 weak-willed. It is not for a weak body, which is 虚弱.
column4: 他的英语基础比较薄弱。
column5: 他的英語基礎比較薄弱。
column6: Tā de Yīngyǔ jīchǔ bǐjiào bóruò.
column7: His English foundation is rather weak.
column9: Weak in an abstract thing, such as a base, a defense or will: 薄弱環節 is the weak link, 基礎薄弱 a weak foundation, 意志薄弱 weak-willed. It is not for a weak body, which is 虛弱.

column3: For cities, cultures, traditions and legends with a very long history: 古老的城市, 古老的传说. Not for people or ordinary old things, which are 老 and 旧.
column6: Zhè shì yī zuò gǔlǎo de chéngshì.
column7: This is an ancient city.
column9: For cities, cultures, traditions and legends with a very long history: 古老的城市, 古老的傳說. Not for people or ordinary old things, which are 老 and 舊.

column3: Long and seemingly endless, for time or a journey, with a sense of weariness: 漫长的冬天, 漫长的等待. Not for a long object or distance in numbers, which is 长.
column6: Dōngtiān zài zhèlǐ hěn màncháng.
column7: Winter is very long here.
column9: Long and seemingly endless, for time or a journey, with a sense of weariness: 漫長的冬天, 漫長的等待. Not for a long object or distance in numbers, which is 長.

column3: Wide in range or extent: 知识面很广, 范围广. Alone it is used mostly for range and scope; for the width of a road or room, 宽 is the word. In speech it mostly lives in compounds such as 广泛, 广告, 广场.
column6: Tā de zhīshimiàn hěn guǎng.
column7: He has very wide knowledge.
column9: Wide in range or extent: 知識面很廣, 範圍廣. Alone it is used mostly for range and scope; for the width of a road or room, 寬 is the word. In speech it mostly lives in compounds such as 廣泛, 廣告, 廣場.

column3: Widespread, extensive, for use, range or influence: 广泛使用, 广泛应用, 广泛的兴趣. It works as an adjective before a noun or as an adverb before a verb. Written and formal in tone.
column6: Shǒujī yǐjīng bèi guǎngfàn shǐyòng.
column7: Cell phones are now widely used.
column9: Widespread, extensive, for use, range or influence: 廣泛使用, 廣泛應用, 廣泛的興趣. It works as an adjective before a noun or as an adverb before a verb. Written and formal in tone.

column3: Vague or blurred, for memory, vision, ideas and boundaries: 记忆模糊, 视线模糊, 模糊不清. It is also a verb, "to blur": 模糊了界限.
column4: 我对那件事的记忆很模糊。
column5: 我對那件事的記憶很模糊。
column6: Wǒ duì nà jiàn shì de jìyì hěn móhu.
column7: My memory of that matter is hazy.
column9: Vague or blurred, for memory, vision, ideas and boundaries: 記憶模糊, 視線模糊, 模糊不清. It is also a verb, "to blur": 模糊了界限.

column3: For a person it means tall and strongly built, not just 高: 身材高大. For trees and buildings, towering: 高大的树. Figuratively it can be lofty: 高大的形象.
column4: 他身材高大，像个运动员。
column5: 他身材高大，像個運動員。
column6: Tā shēncái gāodà, xiàng ge yùndòngyuán.
column7: He is tall and strong, like an athlete.
column9: For a person it means tall and strongly built, not just 高: 身材高大. For trees and buildings, towering: 高大的樹. Figuratively it can be lofty: 高大的形象.

column3: Written and grand, for huge and impressive buildings and landscapes: 雄伟的建筑, 雄伟的山. A person is not described this way.
column6: Chángchéng kànshàngqù fēicháng xióngwěi.
column7: The Great Wall looks magnificent.
column9: Written and grand, for huge and impressive buildings and landscapes: 雄偉的建築, 雄偉的山. A person is not described this way.

column3: In speech it also means "bad" in an annoyed way: 臭脾气 is a foul temper, 臭名声 a bad name. 臭豆腐 is the well-known stinky tofu snack. It combines a dog and a nose, for a dog's strong sense of smell.
column6: Zhè shuāng wàzi tài chòu le.
column7: These socks stink.
column9: In speech it also means "bad" in an annoyed way: 臭脾氣 is a foul temper, 臭名聲 a bad name. 臭豆腐 is the well-known stinky tofu snack. It combines a dog and a nose, for a dog's strong sense of smell.

column3: 度 on the end of an adjective makes a measurable quantity: 长度, 高度, 宽度, 深度. This one follows the thing measured with 的: 河的长度. It also names a figure: 长度为五米.
column4: 这条河的长度有三百公里。
column5: 這條河的長度有三百公里。
column6: Zhè tiáo hé de chángdù yǒu sānbǎi gōnglǐ.
column7: This river is three hundred kilometers long.
column9: 度 on the end of an adjective makes a measurable quantity: 長度, 高度, 寬度, 深度. This one follows the thing measured with 的: 河的長度. It also names a figure: 長度為五米.

column3: Height, as of a plane or mountain: 海拔高度 is altitude. Before an abstract verb or adjective it is a formal intensifier: 高度重视 "attach great importance", 高度紧张.
column4: 飞机飞到了一万米的高度。
column5: 飛機飛到了一萬米的高度。
column6: Fēijī fēi dào le yīwàn mǐ de gāodù.
column7: The plane flew to a height of ten thousand meters.
column9: Height, as of a plane or mountain: 海拔高度 is altitude. Before an abstract verb or adjective it is a formal intensifier: 高度重視 "attach great importance", 高度緊張.

column3: The width of a road, river or room: 路的宽度, 宽度为三米. Often paired with 长度 and 高度 when giving a size.
column4: 这条路的宽度只有两米。
column5: 這條路的寬度只有兩米。
column6: Zhè tiáo lù de kuāndù zhǐyǒu liǎng mǐ.
column7: This road is only two meters wide.
column9: The width of a road, river or room: 路的寬度, 寬度為三米. Often paired with 長度 and 高度 when giving a size.

column3: Depth of water or a hole: 水的深度. Figuratively, depth of thought: 文章缺乏深度. Before a noun it means "in depth": 深度学习 is deep learning, 深度报道 an in-depth report.
column4: 这个湖的深度超过一百米。
column5: 這個湖的深度超過一百米。
column6: Zhège hú de shēndù chāoguò yībǎi mǐ.
column7: This lake is over a hundred meters deep.
column9: Depth of water or a hole: 水的深度. Figuratively, depth of thought: 文章缺乏深度. Before a noun it means "in depth": 深度學習 is deep learning, 深度報道 an in-depth report.

column3: Strength or intensity as a measurable quantity: 运动强度, 光线强度, 材料的强度. Of work, 工作强度大 means a heavy workload. For a person's physical strength, speech says 力气.
column6: Zhè xiàng gōngzuò de qiángdù hěn dà.
column7: This work is very intensive.
column9: Strength or intensity as a measurable quantity: 運動強度, 光線強度, 材料的強度. Of work, 工作強度大 means a heavy workload. For a person's physical strength, speech says 力氣.

column3: The number of countable things: 数目很大, 数目不对 "the count is off". It is the quantity itself, while 数字 is a written figure. As a verb, "to count" is a different word: 数一遍.
column4: 这个数目不太对，请再数一遍。
column5: 這個數目不太對，請再數一遍。
column6: Zhège shùmù bù tài duì, qǐng zài shǔ yī biàn.
column7: This number is not quite right, please count again.
column9: The number of countable things: 數目很大, 數目不對 "the count is off". It is the quantity itself, while 數字 is a written figure. As a verb, "to count" is a different word: 數一遍.

column3: The range or extent of a change: 涨价幅度 is how much prices rose, 幅度大 means large. 大幅度 means "by a wide margin". It measures how far something rises, falls or swings.
column4: 今年房价上涨的幅度不大。
column5: 今年房價上漲的幅度不大。
column6: Jīnnián fángjià shàngzhǎng de fúdù bù dà.
column7: House prices have not risen by much this year.
column9: The range or extent of a change: 漲價幅度 is how much prices rose, 幅度大 means large. 大幅度 means "by a wide margin". It measures how far something rises, falls or swings.

column3: The share of one part in a whole: 占…比重, 所占比重, 比重较大. In physics it is specific gravity. For a percentage as a figure, 比例 is the more common word.
column4: 蔬菜在饮食中的比重应该增加。
column5: 蔬菜在飲食中的比重應該增加。
column6: Shūcài zài yǐnshí zhōng de bǐzhòng yīnggāi zēngjiā.
column7: Vegetables should make up a larger share of the diet.
column9: The share of one part in a whole: 佔…比重, 所佔比重, 比重較大. In physics it is specific gravity. For a percentage as a figure, 比例 is the more common word.

column3: Used for graded quality, status or difficulty: 高等级, 等级制度, 划分等级. For a rank or level inside an organization or a numbered system, 级别 is the common word.
column4: 这些水果分成三个等级。
column5: 這些水果分成三個等級。
column6: Zhèxiē shuǐguǒ fēnchéng sān ge děngjí.
column7: These fruits are sorted into three grades.
column9: Used for graded quality, status or difficulty: 高等級, 等級制度, 劃分等級. For a rank or level inside an organization or a numbered system, 級別 is the common word.

column3: A difference you can measure or point at: 差别很大, 没有差别, 年龄的差别. 区别 leans toward telling things apart: 区别对待, 有区别. On its own 差 is also read chà, to fall short or to lack.
column4: 这两种产品的价格差别很大。
column5: 這兩種產品的價格差別很大。
column6: Zhè liǎng zhǒng chǎnpǐn de jiàgé chābié hěn dà.
column7: The prices of these two products differ greatly.
column9: A difference you can measure or point at: 差別很大, 沒有差別, 年齡的差別. 區別 leans toward telling things apart: 區別對待, 有區別. On its own 差 is also read chà, to fall short or to lack.

column3: A gap that implies one side is behind: 缩小差距, 存在差距, 差距很大. Typical for income, ability, development or scores; for a neutral difference, use 差别.
column4: 我们和他们之间还有很大的差距。
column5: 我們和他們之間還有很大的差距。
column6: Wǒmen hé tāmen zhījiān hái yǒu hěn dà de chājù.
column7: There is still a big gap between us and them.
column9: A gap that implies one side is behind: 縮小差距, 存在差距, 差距很大. Typical for income, ability, development or scores; for a neutral difference, use 差別.

column3: Besides a geometric line (画直线), it works as an adverb before 上升 or 下降 for a sharp rise or fall: 直线上升, 直线下降. 直线距离 is the distance as the crow flies.
column6: Qǐng yòng chǐzi huà yī tiáo zhíxiàn.
column7: Please draw a straight line with a ruler.
column9: Besides a geometric line (畫直線), it works as an adverb before 上升 or 下降 for a sharp rise or fall: 直線上升, 直線下降. 直線距離 is the distance as the crow flies.

column3: Takes its object directly and stretches from touching to meeting: 接触病人, 接触新事物, 很少接触. Often means being exposed to something, not only physical contact.
column4: 他的工作每天都要接触很多人。
column5: 他的工作每天都要接觸很多人。
column6: Tā de gōngzuò měi tiān dōu yào jiēchù hěn duō rén.
column7: His job has him dealing with a lot of people every day.
column9: Takes its object directly and stretches from touching to meeting: 接觸病人, 接觸新事物, 很少接觸. Often means being exposed to something, not only physical contact.

column3: The word for links between things: roads and bridges, but also cables, networks and Wi-Fi (连接网络, 连接失败). The thing joined is the object: 连接A和B.
column4: 这座桥连接着两个城市。
column5: 這座橋連接著兩個城市。
column6: Zhè zuò qiáo liánjiē zhe liǎng ge chéngshì.
column7: This bridge links the two cities.
column9: The word for links between things: roads and bridges, but also cables, networks and Wi-Fi (連接網絡, 連接失敗). The thing joined is the object: 連接A和B.

column3: To merge two things into one: companies, schools, files, cells in a table. The opposite is 分开.
column6: Zhè liǎng jiā gōngsī juédìng hébìng.
column7: These two companies decided to merge.
column9: To merge two things into one: companies, schools, files, cells in a table. The opposite is 分開.

column3: What is passed down is the object: 继承遗产, 继承传统, 继承父业. The one who inherits is the subject. 承 shows a kneeling person and both hands, to hold or carry.
column6: Tā jìchéng le fùqin de gōngsī.
column7: He inherited his father's company.
column9: What is passed down is the object: 繼承遺產, 繼承傳統, 繼承父業. The one who inherits is the subject. 承 shows a kneeling person and both hands, to hold or carry.

column3: More formal than 跟, with a feeling of loyalty or learning: 跟随老师学习, 跟随队伍前进. For plain going along with someone in speech, say 跟.
column4: 孩子们跟随老师参观博物馆。
column5: 孩子們跟隨老師參觀博物館。
column6: Háizimen gēnsuí lǎoshī cānguān bówùguǎn.
column7: The children followed their teacher on a visit to the museum.
column9: More formal than 跟, with a feeling of loyalty or learning: 跟隨老師學習, 跟隨隊伍前進. For plain going along with someone in speech, say 跟.

column3: As a verb it helps a main thing or person; as a modifier it means auxiliary: 辅助工具, 辅助教学, 辅助线. The helper is secondary, never the one in charge.
column4: 这些练习可以辅助你学习汉字。
column5: 這些練習可以輔助你學習漢字。
column6: Zhèxiē liànxí kěyǐ fǔzhù nǐ xuéxí Hànzì.
column7: These exercises can help you study characters.
column9: As a verb it helps a main thing or person; as a modifier it means auxiliary: 輔助工具, 輔助教學, 輔助線. The helper is secondary, never the one in charge.

column3: Something long or open-ended stretches in space, time or meaning: roads, rails and rivers (延伸到), or a topic (话题延伸); 延伸阅读 is "further reading". Often followed by 到 or 向. 延 originally showed walking and a foot, "to travel far".
column4: 这条路一直延伸到海边。
column5: 這條路一直延伸到海邊。
column6: Zhè tiáo lù yīzhí yánshēn dào hǎibiān.
column7: This road stretches all the way to the seaside.
column9: Something long or open-ended stretches in space, time or meaning: roads, rails and rivers (延伸到), or a topic (話題延伸); 延伸閱讀 is "further reading". Often followed by 到 or 向. 延 originally showed walking and a foot, "to travel far".

column3: Go around an obstacle or a place: 绕过, 绕路, 绕圈子. Also to wind: 绕线. Figuratively, 绕远 is a long way around, and 别绕了 means stop beating around the bush.
column4: 我们绕了一大圈才找到那家店。
column5: 我們繞了一大圈才找到那家店。
column6: Wǒmen rào le yī dà quān cái zhǎodào nà jiā diàn.
column7: We went around in a big circle before we found that shop.
column9: Go around an obstacle or a place: 繞過, 繞路, 繞圈子. Also to wind: 繞線. Figuratively, 繞遠 is a long way around, and 別繞了 means stop beating around the bush.

column3: Parting of things that belong together, often against one's wishes: 母子分离, 夫妻分离. Also a lab word for separating a mixture: 分离出来.
column6: Zhànzhēng shǐ tāmen chángqī fēnlí.
column7: The war kept them apart for a long time.
column9: Parting of things that belong together, often against one's wishes: 母子分離, 夫妻分離. Also a lab word for separating a mixture: 分離出來.

column3: Takes the thing left as its object: 脱离危险, 脱离实际 "get out of touch with reality", 脱离群众. Often used for escaping something bad.
column4: 病人已经脱离了生命危险。
column5: 病人已經脫離了生命危險。
column6: Bìngrén yǐjīng tuōlí le shēngmìng wēixiǎn.
column7: The patient is now out of danger.
column9: Takes the thing left as its object: 脫離危險, 脫離實際 "get out of touch with reality", 脫離群眾. Often used for escaping something bad.

column3: Pattern: 把A分成B, with the result after 成: 分成两组, 分成三份. A second use is a share of income, e.g. 三七分成, a 30/70 split.
column4: 老师把学生分成了四个小组。
column5: 老師把學生分成了四個小組。
column6: Lǎoshī bǎ xuésheng fēnchéng le sì ge xiǎozǔ.
column7: The teacher divided the students into four groups.
column9: Pattern: 把A分成B, with the result after 成: 分成兩組, 分成三份. A second use is a share of income, e.g. 三七分成, a 30/70 split.

column3: Describes things that come with a main item so it works: 配套设施, 配套服务, 配套政策. It is also a verb: 配套使用.
column4: 新社区的配套设施很齐全。
column5: 新社區的配套設施很齊全。
column6: Xīn shèqū de pèitào shèshī hěn qíquán.
column7: The new neighborhood has a full range of supporting facilities.
column9: Describes things that come with a main item so it works: 配套設施, 配套服務, 配套政策. It is also a verb: 配套使用.

column3: Physical construction from the ground up: 建造房子, 建造大桥, 建造工厂. For organizations, ideas or relationships, use 建立 instead. 建 was originally a picture of a hand planting a pole.
column4: 他们正在河边建造一座新桥。
column5: 他們正在河邊建造一座新橋。
column6: Tāmen zhèngzài hé biān jiànzào yī zuò xīn qiáo.
column7: They are building a new bridge by the river.
column9: Physical construction from the ground up: 建造房子, 建造大橋, 建造工廠. For organizations, ideas or relationships, use 建立 instead. 建 was originally a picture of a hand planting a pole.

column3: Mostly a noun: a building or architecture (古代建筑, 建筑风格, 建筑师). Built objects are 建筑物. Less common as a verb: 建筑铁路.
column4: 这座城市有很多古老的建筑。
column5: 這座城市有很多古老的建築。
column6: Zhè zuò chéngshì yǒu hěn duō gǔlǎo de jiànzhù.
column7: This city has many old buildings.
column9: Mostly a noun: a building or architecture (古代建築, 建築風格, 建築師). Built objects are 建築物. Less common as a verb: 建築鐵路.

column3: The verb for public works: 修建铁路, 修建公路, 修建水库. Fits large projects, and sounds a little more official than plain 建.
column4: 政府打算在这里修建一条高速公路。
column5: 政府打算在這裡修建一條高速公路。
column6: Zhèngfǔ dǎsuàn zài zhèlǐ xiūjiàn yī tiáo gāosùgōnglù.
column7: The government plans to build an expressway here.
column9: The verb for public works: 修建鐵路, 修建公路, 修建水庫. Fits large projects, and sounds a little more official than plain 建.

column3: Pattern: 用 or 由 + material + 制成: 用竹子制成. Used for finished products. Passive-like, often ending in 的: 是……制成的.
column4: 这张桌子是用竹子制成的。
column5: 這張桌子是用竹子製成的。
column6: Zhè zhāng zhuōzi shì yòng zhúzi zhìchéng de.
column7: This table is made of bamboo.
column9: Pattern: 用 or 由 + material + 製成: 用竹子製成. Used for finished products. Passive-like, often ending in 的: 是……製成的.

column3: Comes into being or is produced by a process: 自动生成, 生成报告, 生成新文件. Common in science and computing, with a feeling of automatic output.
column4: 这个工具会自动生成报告。
column5: 這個工具會自動生成報告。
column6: Zhège gōngjù huì zìdòng shēngchéng bàogào.
column7: This tool generates a report automatically.
column9: Comes into being or is produced by a process: 自動生成, 生成報告, 生成新文件. Common in science and computing, with a feeling of automatic output.

column3: To combine parts into one whole: sounds, images, chemicals. As a modifier it means synthetic: 合成材料, 合成纤维, 合成图片.
column4: 这张照片是用电脑合成的。
column5: 這張照片是用電腦合成的。
column6: Zhè zhāng zhàopiàn shì yòng diànnǎo héchéng de.
column7: This photo was put together on a computer.
column9: To combine parts into one whole: sounds, images, chemicals. As a modifier it means synthetic: 合成材料, 合成纖維, 合成圖片.

column3: Used for chemical breakdown and for taking apart a task or motion: 分解动作, 分解成几步. 解 shows a knife separating a horn from a cow.
column6: Xìjūn kěyǐ fēnjiě lājī.
column7: Bacteria can break down garbage.
column9: Used for chemical breakdown and for taking apart a task or motion: 分解動作, 分解成幾步. 解 shows a knife separating a horn from a cow.

column3: A verb and a noun: 垃圾分类, 按颜色分类, 把书分类. The criterion comes after 按: 按大小分类.
column4: 我们把图书按内容分类。
column5: 我們把圖書按內容分類。
column6: Wǒmen bǎ túshū àn nèiróng fēnlèi.
column7: We sort the books by subject.
column9: A verb and a noun: 垃圾分類, 按顏色分類, 把書分類. The criterion comes after 按: 按大小分類.

column3: To divide by drawing boundaries: regions, periods, responsibilities. Pattern: 把A划分为B: 划分地区, 划分责任. 划 is read hua4 here, "to delimit", and hua2 when it means to row a boat.
column4: 这个国家被划分为二十个省。
column5: 這個國家被劃分為二十個省。
column6: Zhège guójiā bèi huàfēn wéi èrshí ge shěng.
column7: This country is divided into twenty provinces.
column9: To divide by drawing boundaries: regions, periods, responsibilities. Pattern: 把A劃分為B: 劃分地區, 劃分責任. 劃 is read hua4 here, "to delimit", and hua2 when it means to row a boat.

column3: Both the act of packing for sale and the packaging itself: 包装纸, 礼品包装. Figuratively, it means to build up someone's image, 包装明星. 包 was a picture of a baby in the womb, or a swaddled baby.
column4: 这份礼物的包装非常漂亮。
column5: 這份禮物的包裝非常漂亮。
column6: Zhè fèn lǐwù de bāozhuāng fēicháng piàoliang.
column7: The wrapping of this gift is very beautiful.
column9: Both the act of packing for sale and the packaging itself: 包裝紙, 禮品包裝. Figuratively, it means to build up someone's image, 包裝明星. 包 was a picture of a baby in the womb, or a swaddled baby.

column3: A fuller fix than 修理: restoring something to its former state. Used for relics, roads, bugs and relationships: 修复文物, 修复漏洞, 修复关系.
column4: 工人们正在修复被雨水冲坏的路。
column5: 工人們正在修復被雨水沖壞的路。
column6: Gōngrénmen zhèngzài xiūfù bèi yǔshuǐ chōnghuài de lù.
column7: Workers are repairing the road that the rain washed out.
column9: A fuller fix than 修理: restoring something to its former state. Used for relics, roads, bugs and relationships: 修復文物, 修復漏洞, 修復關係.

column3: To decorate a place or object, and also the decoration: 装饰房间, 装饰品, 装饰画. The object decorated comes after, and 用 names the materials.
column6: Tā yòng xiānhuā zhuāngshì le kètīng.
column7: She decorated the living room with fresh flowers.
column9: To decorate a place or object, and also the decoration: 裝飾房間, 裝飾品, 裝飾畫. The object decorated comes after, and 用 names the materials.

column3: A change to arrangements, figures or staff: 人事变动, 价格变动, 没有变动. It is narrower than 变化, which covers any change, even a gradual natural one such as 天气变化.
column4: 公司最近有一些人事变动。
column5: 公司最近有一些人事變動。
column6: Gōngsī zuìjìn yǒu yīxiē rénshì biàndòng.
column7: The company has had some personnel changes recently.
column9: A change to arrangements, figures or staff: 人事變動, 價格變動, 沒有變動. It is narrower than 變化, which covers any change, even a gradual natural one such as 天氣變化.

column3: The word for software and app updates: 更新系统, 软件更新. Also used for refreshing knowledge, a page or a list: 知识更新, 更新内容. Here 更 is read gēng, to change or replace, not gèng as in 更好.
column6: Shǒujī xūyào gēngxīn xìtǒng le.
column7: The phone needs a system update.
column9: The word for software and app updates: 更新系統, 軟件更新. Also used for refreshing knowledge, a page or a list: 知識更新, 更新內容. Here 更 is read gēng, to change or replace, not gèng as in 更好.

column3: Swapping an old or worn part for a new one: 更换轮胎, 更换电池, 更换密码. Also for changing details like an address. For a software update, say 更新.
column4: 你该更换这个旧电池了。
column5: 你該更換這個舊電池了。
column6: Nǐ gāi gēnghuàn zhège jiù diànchí le.
column7: You should replace this old battery.
column9: Swapping an old or worn part for a new one: 更換輪胎, 更換電池, 更換密碼. Also for changing details like an address. For a software update, say 更新.

column3: Pattern: A转化为B or A转化成B: 转化为能量. It suggests a change of kind, not just of form.
column4: 这种机器把热能转化为电能。
column5: 這種機器把熱能轉化為電能。
column6: Zhè zhǒng jīqì bǎ rènéng zhuǎnhuà wéi diànnéng.
column7: This machine turns heat energy into electricity.
column9: Pattern: A轉化為B or A轉化成B: 轉化為能量. It suggests a change of kind, not just of form.

column3: To switch from one mode, format or role to another: 转换格式, 转换角色, 转换思路. Pattern: 转换成.
column6: Qǐng bǎ wénjiàn zhuǎnhuàn chéng PDF géshì.
column7: Please convert the file to PDF format.
column9: To switch from one mode, format or role to another: 轉換格式, 轉換角色, 轉換思路. Pattern: 轉換成.

column3: To change direction, of a vehicle or a person: 向右转向. Also figurative: 转向新能源. As a noun, 转向灯 is a turn signal.
column6: Qìchē tūrán xiàng yòu zhuǎnxiàng.
column7: The car suddenly turned right.
column9: To change direction, of a vehicle or a person: 向右轉向. Also figurative: 轉向新能源. As a noun, 轉向燈 is a turn signal.

column3: A formal, business word for handing over a right, property or shop to another, with or without pay: 转让股份, 转让房子. Shop signs say 店面转让.
column6: Tā bǎ diàn zhuǎnràng gěi le péngyou.
column7: He transferred the shop to a friend.
column9: A formal, business word for handing over a right, property or shop to another, with or without pay: 轉讓股份, 轉讓房子. Shop signs say 店面轉讓.

column3: To move someone to another post or to move troops, and to mobilize: 工作调动, 调动积极性. The word is common in job and army contexts. 调 is read diào here, "to transfer", but tiáo in words like 调节.
column4: 公司把他调动到上海分公司。
column5: 公司把他調動到上海分公司。
column6: Gōngsī bǎ tā diàodòng dào Shànghǎi fēngōngsī.
column7: The company transferred him to the Shanghai branch.
column9: To move someone to another post or to move troops, and to mobilize: 工作調動, 調動積極性. The word is common in job and army contexts. 調 is read diào here, "to transfer", but tiáo in words like 調節.

column3: Fine adjustment of a degree or balance: 调节温度, 调节心情, 调节器. Used for machines and for body or mood.
column4: 你可以自己调节空调的温度。
column5: 你可以自己調節空調的溫度。
column6: Nǐ kěyǐ zìjǐ tiáojié kōngtiáo de wēndù.
column7: You can adjust the air conditioner's temperature yourself.
column9: Fine adjustment of a degree or balance: 調節溫度, 調節心情, 調節器. Used for machines and for body or mood.

column3: What a third party does in a dispute: 调解纠纷, 调解员, 法院调解. The two sides settle by agreement and no verdict is imposed.
column4: 社区工作人员帮他们调解了矛盾。
column5: 社區工作人員幫他們調解了矛盾。
column6: Shèqū gōngzuò rényuán bāng tāmen tiáojiě le máodùn.
column7: A community worker helped mediate their quarrel.
column9: What a third party does in a dispute: 調解糾紛, 調解員, 法院調解. The two sides settle by agreement and no verdict is imposed.

column3: Liquids, air, people and money move around: 空气流动, 流动人口, 流动资金. As a modifier it means mobile: 流动摊贩, 流动图书馆.
column4: 河水在山谷里慢慢流动。
column5: 河水在山谷裡慢慢流動。
column6: Héshuǐ zài shāngǔ lǐ mànmàn liúdòng.
column7: The river flows slowly through the valley.
column9: Liquids, air, people and money move around: 空氣流動, 流動人口, 流動資金. As a modifier it means mobile: 流動攤販, 流動圖書館.

column3: Goods, money, information or air pass freely without blockage: 商品流通, 货币流通, 空气流通. Often an economic word.
column4: 这种新钞已经开始在市场上流通。
column5: 這種新鈔已經開始在市場上流通。
column6: Zhè zhǒng xīn chāo yǐjīng kāishǐ zài shìchǎng shàng liútōng.
column7: This new banknote has started to circulate in the market.
column9: Goods, money, information or air pass freely without blockage: 商品流通, 貨幣流通, 空氣流通. Often an economic word.

column3: News on how a situation is developing: 最新动态, 市场动态, 关注动态. Also a social-media post or status update (发动态), and "dynamic" as an adjective, opposite of 静态.
column4: 我们要随时关注市场的动态。
column5: 我們要隨時關注市場的動態。
column6: Wǒmen yào suíshí guānzhù shìchǎng de dòngtài.
column7: We must keep following developments in the market at all times.
column9: News on how a situation is developing: 最新動態, 市場動態, 關注動態. Also a social-media post or status update (發動態), and "dynamic" as an adjective, opposite of 靜態.

column3: A bound form: it rarely stands alone, but starts many words of rising or adding such as 增加, 增长, 增强, 增产. Opposite of 减. Its 土 means earth: things grow in the earth, to build from earth.
column4: 今年游客人数比去年增了两成。
column5: 今年遊客人數比去年增了兩成。
column6: Jīnnián yóukè rénshù bǐ qùnián zēng le liǎng chéng.
column7: Visitors this year are up twenty percent over last year.
column9: A bound form: it rarely stands alone, but starts many words of rising or adding such as 增加, 增長, 增強, 增產. Opposite of 減. Its 土 means earth: things grow in the earth, to build from earth.

column3: Output rises, of crops, factories or oil: 粮食增产, 增产增收. The opposite is 减产.
column6: Jīnnián xiǎomài dàfú zēngchǎn.
column7: Wheat output has risen sharply this year.
column9: Output rises, of crops, factories or oil: 糧食增產, 增產增收. The opposite is 減產.

column3: Grows in size, force or degree, for measurable things: 压力增大, 增大风险, 增大面积. It takes an object or stands as a result.
column6: Zhèyàng zuò huì zēngdà fēngxiǎn.
column7: Doing it this way will increase the risk.
column9: Grows in size, force or degree, for measurable things: 壓力增大, 增大風險, 增大面積. It takes an object or stands as a result.

column3: Grows in number or amount, usually of countable things or events: 游客增多, 人数增多. It cannot take an object.
column4: 夏天来了，游客明显增多。
column5: 夏天來了，遊客明顯增多。
column6: Xiàtiān lái le, yóukè míngxiǎn zēngduō.
column7: Summer has come, and the number of tourists has clearly increased.
column9: Grows in number or amount, usually of countable things or events: 遊客增多, 人數增多. It cannot take an object.

column3: Strengthens something that already exists: 增强体质, 增强信心, 增强意识. The object is an ability or a quality, not a person.
column6: Duō yùndòng kěyǐ zēngqiáng tǐzhì.
column7: More exercise can strengthen the body.
column9: Strengthens something that already exists: 增強體質, 增強信心, 增強意識. The object is an ability or a quality, not a person.

column3: Speeds up a process or a vehicle. Slightly more technical than 加快: 加速发展, 加速度 "acceleration".
column4: 车子慢慢加速，开上了高速公路。
column5: 車子慢慢加速，開上了高速公路。
column6: Chēzi mànmàn jiāsù, kāishàng le gāosùgōnglù.
column7: The car slowly sped up and drove onto the expressway.
column9: Speeds up a process or a vehicle. Slightly more technical than 加快: 加速發展, 加速度 "acceleration".

column3: Of a level or a measure that climbs on a scale, such as temperature, blood pressure or price: 气温升高, 血压升高. It can take an amount: 升高了两度.
column4: 天气转暖，气温慢慢升高。
column5: 天氣轉暖，氣溫慢慢升高。
column6: Tiānqì zhuǎn nuǎn, qìwēn mànmàn shēnggāo.
column7: As the weather warms, the temperature rises slowly.
column9: Of a level or a measure that climbs on a scale, such as temperature, blood pressure or price: 氣溫升高, 血壓升高. It can take an amount: 升高了兩度.

column3: To enlarge or magnify: 放大照片, 放大镜. For sound it means to turn up, and for problems it means to exaggerate.
column4: 请把这张照片放大一点儿。
column5: 請把這張照片放大一點兒。
column6: Qǐng bǎ zhè zhāng zhàopiàn fàngdà yīdiǎnr.
column7: Please enlarge this photo a little.
column9: To enlarge or magnify: 放大照片, 放大鏡. For sound it means to turn up, and for problems it means to exaggerate.

column3: Also a conjunction at the start of a clause: "on top of that", 加上天气不好. As a verb it adds one thing to another: 再加上一点盐, 名字后面加上日期.
column4: 他很聪明，加上努力，成绩一直很好。
column5: 他很聰明，加上努力，成績一直很好。
column6: Tā hěn cōngming, jiāshang nǔlì, chéngjì yīzhí hěn hǎo.
column7: He is smart, and on top of that he works hard, so his grades have always been good.
column9: Also a conjunction at the start of a clause: "on top of that", 加上天氣不好. As a verb it adds one thing to another: 再加上一點鹽, 名字後面加上日期.

column3: Takes the thing heated as its object, and 到 plus a temperature: 加热食物, 加热到一百度. It is the general word, used in speech and on labels; for warming up leftovers people often just say 热一下.
column6: Bǎ niúnǎi jiārè hòu zài hē.
column7: Heat the milk before you drink it.
column9: Takes the thing heated as its object, and 到 plus a temperature: 加熱食物, 加熱到一百度. It is the general word, used in speech and on labels; for warming up leftovers people often just say 熱一下.

column3: Describes an economy, a market, a city or a culture that is thriving, not a person or a single shop. A written, positive word; 繁荣昌盛 is the set phrase for a nation. It can also be a verb: 繁荣市场.
column4: 这个城市的经济非常繁荣。
column5: 這個城市的經濟非常繁榮。
column6: Zhège chéngshì de jīngjì fēicháng fánróng.
column7: This city's economy is very prosperous.
column9: Describes an economy, a market, a city or a culture that is thriving, not a person or a single shop. A written, positive word; 繁榮昌盛 is the set phrase for a nation. It can also be a verb: 繁榮市場.

column3: Takes what comes back as its object (恢复健康, 恢复正常, 恢复联系), or stands alone when the thing recovers by itself: 体力恢复了. It is also the word for services returning, as in 恢复供电 and 恢复营业.
column4: 经过休息，他的体力慢慢恢复了。
column5: 經過休息，他的體力慢慢恢復了。
column6: Jīngguò xiūxi, tā de tǐlì mànmàn huīfù le.
column7: After rest, his strength slowly came back.
column9: Takes what comes back as its object (恢復健康, 恢復正常, 恢復聯繫), or stands alone when the thing recovers by itself: 體力恢復了. It is also the word for services returning, as in 恢復供電 and 恢復營業.

column3: Clears away something unwanted that is felt rather than built, such as 误会, 疲劳, 疑虑 or 影响. Compare 解除, for lifting a restriction or a worry, and 排除, for getting an obstacle out of the way. 消 is explained as a word for putting something out with water.
column4: 这次谈话消除了我们之间的误会。
column5: 這次談話消除了我們之間的誤會。
column6: Zhè cì tánhuà xiāochú le wǒmen zhījiān de wùhuì.
column7: This talk cleared up the misunderstanding between us.
column9: Clears away something unwanted that is felt rather than built, such as 誤會, 疲勞, 疑慮 or 影響. Compare 解除, for lifting a restriction or a worry, and 排除, for getting an obstacle out of the way. 消 is explained as a word for putting something out with water.

column3: Lifts something that binds or restricts: 解除合同, 解除禁令, 解除警报, 解除隔离. It is formal. It also lifts what weighs on someone: 解除顾虑, 解除痛苦. 消除 wipes out 误会, 疲劳 and 影响. 解 is explained as a knife separating a horn from a cow.
column4: 公司解除了和他的合同。
column5: 公司解除了和他的合同。
column6: Gōngsī jiěchú le hé tā de hétong.
column7: The company terminated its contract with him.
column9: Lifts something that binds or restricts: 解除合同, 解除禁令, 解除警報, 解除隔離. It is formal. It also lifts what weighs on someone: 解除顧慮, 解除痛苦. 消除 wipes out 誤會, 疲勞 and 影響. 解 is explained as a knife separating a horn from a cow.

column3: Gets what is in the way out of the way, or rules out a possibility: 排除困难, 排除障碍, 排除嫌疑, 排除故障. The object is usually an obstacle or a possibility. 排 also means to line things up, and it counts rows of them.
column4: 警方没有排除任何可能。
column5: 警方沒有排除任何可能。
column6: Jǐngfāng méiyǒu páichú rènhé kěnéng.
column7: The police have not ruled out any possibility.
column9: Gets what is in the way out of the way, or rules out a possibility: 排除困難, 排除障礙, 排除嫌疑, 排除故障. The object is usually an obstacle or a possibility. 排 also means to line things up, and it counts rows of them.

column3: The official verb for taking down a structure or removing a device: 拆除违章建筑, 拆除炸弹 (news staples). 拆 alone is the everyday verb and also means to open or unpack: 拆快递.
column4: 这座旧楼下个月就要拆除了。
column5: 這座舊樓下個月就要拆除了。
column6: Zhè zuò jiù lóu xià ge yuè jiù yào chāichú le.
column7: This old building will be torn down next month.
column9: The official verb for taking down a structure or removing a device: 拆除違章建築, 拆除炸彈 (news staples). 拆 alone is the everyday verb and also means to open or unpack: 拆快遞.

column3: For something in progress that stops short, often against anyone's plan: 通话中断, 信号中断, 供电中断. The thing can be the subject (电话中断了) or the object (中断学业). For a deliberate pause, use 暂停.
column6: Diànhuà tūrán zhōngduàn le.
column7: The call was suddenly cut off.
column9: For something in progress that stops short, often against anyone's plan: 通話中斷, 信號中斷, 供電中斷. The thing can be the subject (電話中斷了) or the object (中斷學業). For a deliberate pause, use 暫停.

column3: The formal word for ending something for good, by decision: 终止合同, 终止谈判, 终止合作, and 终止妊娠 in medicine. Compare 暂停, a pause that will end, and 中断, a stop that breaks in on something.
column6: Shuāngfāng tóngyì zhōngzhǐ hézuò.
column7: Both sides agreed to end the cooperation.
column9: The formal word for ending something for good, by decision: 終止合同, 終止談判, 終止合作, and 終止妊娠 in medicine. Compare 暫停, a pause that will end, and 中斷, a stop that breaks in on something.

column3: Takes what is given up (放弃机会, 放弃计划) or stands alone: 不要放弃! It means choosing to stop trying, also when you drop out of a race or an exam. 弃 is also in 抛弃 and 弃权, to abstain or forfeit.
column4: 不管多难，我都不会放弃。
column5: 不管多難，我都不會放棄。
column6: Bùguǎn duō nán, wǒ dōu bù huì fàngqì.
column7: No matter how hard it is, I will not give up.
column9: Takes what is given up (放棄機會, 放棄計劃) or stands alone: 不要放棄! It means choosing to stop trying, also when you drop out of a race or an exam. 棄 is also in 拋棄 and 棄權, to abstain or forfeit.

column3: To avoid something or someone on purpose, not to face it: 回避问题 "dodge a question", 回避矛盾 "avoid conflict", 不要回避. It also means to step aside for a conflict of interest (a judge who recuses himself). 回 "turn back" + 避 "avoid".
column6: Tā zǒngshì huíbì zhège wèntí.
column7: He always avoids this question.
column9: To avoid something or someone on purpose, not to face it: 回避問題 "dodge a question", 回避矛盾 "avoid conflict", 不要回避. It also means to step aside for a conflict of interest (a judge who recuses himself). 回 "turn back" + 避 "avoid".

column3: Collects things back for reuse or return, the word on recycling bins: 可回收物 on the mainland, 资源回收 in Taiwan. Money can come back too: 回收成本, 回收资金.
column4: 这些旧衣服可以回收再利用。
column5: 這些舊衣服可以回收再利用。
column6: Zhèxiē jiù yīfu kěyǐ huíshōu zài lìyòng.
column7: These old clothes can be collected and reused.
column9: Collects things back for reuse or return, the word on recycling bins: 可回收物 on the mainland, 資源回收 in Taiwan. Money can come back too: 回收成本, 回收資金.

column3: Clears out what is not wanted: junk, trash, files, debts (清理账目). 整理 arranges what stays, and 打扫 is sweeping and wiping a room. On a phone, 清理缓存 clears the cache.
column4: 周末我要清理一下书房。
column5: 週末我要清理一下書房。
column6: Zhōumò wǒ yào qīnglǐ yīxià shūfáng.
column7: I'm going to clear out the study this weekend.
column9: Clears out what is not wanted: junk, trash, files, debts (清理帳目). 整理 arranges what stays, and 打掃 is sweeping and wiping a room. On a phone, 清理緩存 clears the cache.

column3: Puts things away or packs them: 收拾桌子, 收拾房间, 收拾行李. It is tidying, not scrubbing; for sweeping and wiping, 打扫. In speech it can also be a threat: 看我怎么收拾你, "just watch what I'll do to you".
column4: 吃完饭后，我帮妈妈收拾桌子。
column5: 吃完飯後，我幫媽媽收拾桌子。
column6: Chī wán fàn hòu, wǒ bāng māma shōushi zhuōzi.
column7: After the meal, I helped Mom clear the table.
column9: Puts things away or packs them: 收拾桌子, 收拾房間, 收拾行李. It is tidying, not scrubbing; for sweeping and wiping, 打掃. In speech it can also be a threat: 看我怎麼收拾你, "just watch what I'll do to you".

column3: A stop expected to end: 暂停营业, 暂停比赛, and the pause button on a player. In sports, calling a timeout is 叫暂停. Unlike 终止, it leaves the thing to be resumed. In Taiwan, 暂 has another reading, zhàn.
column6: Yīnwèi xià yǔ, bǐsài zàntíng le.
column7: The match was suspended because of the rain.
column9: A stop expected to end: 暫停營業, 暫停比賽, and the pause button on a player. In sports, calling a timeout is 叫暫停. Unlike 終止, it leaves the thing to be resumed. In Taiwan, 暫 has another reading, zhàn.

column3: The end of a route or a race: 到达终点, 终点线, and 终点站 for the last stop on a line. The opposite is 起点. It also works for the end of a long process. 终 began as a picture of the knot at the end of a cord.
column4: 他第一个冲过了终点线。
column5: 他第一個衝過了終點線。
column6: Tā dì yī ge chōngguò le zhōngdiǎn xiàn.
column7: He was the first to dash across the finish line.
column9: The end of a route or a race: 到達終點, 終點線, and 終點站 for the last stop on a line. The opposite is 起點. It also works for the end of a long process. 終 began as a picture of the knot at the end of a cord.

column3: Lessens how heavy something feels: 减轻负担, 减轻压力, 减轻痛苦, 减轻症状. 减少 lowers a number or amount instead; for losing weight, people say 减肥.
column6: Zhè zhǒng yào kěyǐ jiǎnqīng téngtòng.
column7: This medicine can ease the pain.
column9: Lessens how heavy something feels: 減輕負擔, 減輕壓力, 減輕痛苦, 減輕症狀. 減少 lowers a number or amount instead; for losing weight, people say 減肥.

column3: A formal, polite 等 for waiting for a person, a notice or a result: 等候通知, 请在这里等候. 候 turns up where people wait: 候车室, 候诊室 (waiting rooms).
column4: 请在大厅等候，医生马上就来。
column5: 請在大廳等候，醫生馬上就來。
column6: Qǐng zài dàtīng děnghòu, yīshēng mǎshàng jiù lái.
column7: Please wait in the hall; the doctor will be right here.
column9: A formal, polite 等 for waiting for a person, a notice or a result: 等候通知, 請在這裡等候. 候 turns up where people wait: 候車室, 候診室 (waiting rooms).

column3: Spoken, for staying in a place, with the place after it: 待在家里, 待一会儿, 待不下去. The same word is often written 呆 (呆在家里).
column4: 周末我想待在家里休息。
column5: 週末我想待在家裡休息。
column6: Zhōumò wǒ xiǎng dāi zài jiālǐ xiūxi.
column7: I want to stay at home and rest this weekend.
column9: Spoken, for staying in a place, with the place after it: 待在家裡, 待一會兒, 待不下去. The same word is often written 呆 (呆在家裡).

column3: Describes a blank, unresponsive look: 发呆 is spacing out, 吓呆了 is frozen with shock, and 书呆子 is a bookworm with no common sense. In writing, 呆 is often used for 待, to stay: 呆在家里.
column4: 听到这个消息，他整个人都呆了。
column5: 聽到這個消息，他整個人都呆了。
column6: Tīngdào zhège xiāoxi, tā zhěng ge rén dōu dāi le.
column7: On hearing the news, he was struck dumb.
column9: Describes a blank, unresponsive look: 發呆 is spacing out, 嚇呆了 is frozen with shock, and 書呆子 is a bookworm with no common sense. In writing, 呆 is often used for 待, to stay: 呆在家裡.

column3: A stop along the way, as in transit or on a trip: 停留三天, 在机场停留. For where you sleep, say 住. It can also be a stage that is not passed: 停留在表面, "stay on the surface".
column4: 我们在上海停留了三天。
column5: 我們在上海停留了三天。
column6: Wǒmen zài Shànghǎi tíngliú le sān tiān.
column7: We stayed in Shanghai for three days.
column9: A stop along the way, as in transit or on a trip: 停留三天, 在機場停留. For where you sleep, say 住. It can also be a stage that is not passed: 停留在表面, "stay on the surface".

column3: Late in the sense of behind schedule or past a deadline, mostly inside words: 迟到, 推迟, 迟早, 迟交. On its own it is common in 不迟 and 来迟了; for a late hour or arriving after others, 晚 is more usual.
column6: Xiànzài kāishǐ xué yě bù chí.
column7: It's not too late to start learning now.
column9: Late in the sense of behind schedule or past a deadline, mostly inside words: 遲到, 推遲, 遲早, 遲交. On its own it is common in 不遲 and 來遲了; for a late hour or arriving after others, 晚 is more usual.

column3: The arrival of a season, a time or an event: 春天的到来, 新年的到来. Polite phrases use it for a guest too: 感谢您的到来. A written noun, and also a verb: 假期即将到来. 来 began as a picture of wheat, and was borrowed for "to come".
column4: 春天的到来让大家心情很好。
column5: 春天的到來讓大家心情很好。
column6: Chūntiān de dàolái ràng dàjiā xīnqíng hěn hǎo.
column7: The arrival of spring puts everyone in a good mood.
column9: The arrival of a season, a time or an event: 春天的到來, 新年的到來. Polite phrases use it for a guest too: 感謝您的到來. A written noun, and also a verb: 假期即將到來. 來 began as a picture of wheat, and was borrowed for "to come".

column3: The moment when an action will work: 把握时机, 时机成熟, 等待时机. 机会 is a chance that comes to you; 时机 is about timing. 机 as "chance" also appears in 良机, 商机 and 转机.
column4: 现在还不是出手的时机。
column5: 現在還不是出手的時機。
column6: Xiànzài hái bù shì chūshǒu de shíjī.
column7: Now is not yet the time to act.
column9: The moment when an action will work: 把握時機, 時機成熟, 等待時機. 機會 is a chance that comes to you; 時機 is about timing. 機 as "chance" also appears in 良機, 商機 and 轉機.

column3: The affairs of the day in the news: 关心时事, 时事评论, 时事新闻. 新闻 is one report; 时事 is the whole ongoing picture, and also a school or exam topic.
column4: 他每天看报纸，很关心时事。
column5: 他每天看報紙，很關心時事。
column6: Tā měi tiān kàn bàozhǐ, hěn guānxīn shíshì.
column7: He reads the paper every day and follows current affairs closely.
column9: The affairs of the day in the news: 關心時事, 時事評論, 時事新聞. 新聞 is one report; 時事 is the whole ongoing picture, and also a school or exam topic.

column3: A weighty matter: 国家大事, 终身大事 (a marriage). In speech the common use is the comfort 不是什么大事, "it is no big deal". The opposite is 小事, and 大事化小 is to play something down. 事 is explained as a flag in hand, meaning to perform one's job.
column4: 结婚是人生中的一件大事。
column5: 結婚是人生中的一件大事。
column6: Jiéhūn shì rénshēng zhōng de yī jiàn dàshì.
column7: Getting married is a major event in life.
column9: A weighty matter: 國家大事, 終身大事 (a marriage). In speech the common use is the comfort 不是什麼大事, "it is no big deal". The opposite is 小事, and 大事化小 is to play something down. 事 is explained as a flag in hand, meaning to perform one's job.

column3: Getting ready in advance. In speech 准备 is the usual word; 预备 survives in set uses such as 预备班 and 预备役. 预备，开始！ is the start command. 预 means "in advance" in 预习, 预订 and 预报 too.
column6: Dàjiā yùbèi hǎo le ma?
column7: Is everyone ready?
column9: Getting ready in advance. In speech 準備 is the usual word; 預備 survives in set uses such as 預備班 and 預備役. 預備，開始！ is the start command. 預 means "in advance" in 預習, 預訂 and 預報 too.

column3: An adverb before the verb or number, for events of one kind following each other: 接连几天, 接连三次, 接连发生. 连续 is broader and also a modifier: 连续剧, 连续三天.
column4: 这个月接连下了好几场大雨。
column5: 這個月接連下了好幾場大雨。
column6: Zhège yuè jiēlián xià le hǎo jǐ chǎng dàyǔ.
column7: It has rained heavily several times in a row this month.
column9: An adverb before the verb or number, for events of one kind following each other: 接連幾天, 接連三次, 接連發生. 連續 is broader and also a modifier: 連續劇, 連續三天.

column3: Happening often, written style: 往来频繁, 频繁出差, 频繁地更换. It can be an adjective or an adverb, and often counts something noticeable or unwelcome. In speech, 经常 is the usual word.
column6: Zuìjìn tā chūchāi hěn pínfán.
column7: He has been on business trips very often lately.
column9: Happening often, written style: 往來頻繁, 頻繁出差, 頻繁地更換. It can be an adjective or an adverb, and often counts something noticeable or unwelcome. In speech, 經常 is the usual word.

column3: Brings something up in talk: 提起这件事, 从不提起. 一提起…就… is "whenever X comes up". It also lifts or raises: 提起精神, 提起勇气, and 提起诉讼 is to file a lawsuit.
column4: 她从来不愿提起过去的事。
column5: 她從來不願提起過去的事。
column6: Tā cónglái bù yuàn tíqǐ guòqù de shì.
column7: She has never been willing to talk about the past.
column9: Brings something up in talk: 提起這件事, 從不提起. 一提起…就… is "whenever X comes up". It also lifts or raises: 提起精神, 提起勇氣, and 提起訴訟 is to file a lawsuit.

column3: The pattern is 鼓励 + person + verb: 鼓励他继续努力. It is also a noun: 受到鼓励, 一种鼓励. It is the steady support of a teacher or parent; the shout of the moment is 加油.
column4: 老师鼓励我们多说汉语。
column5: 老師鼓勵我們多說漢語。
column6: Lǎoshī gǔlì wǒmen duō shuō Hànyǔ.
column7: The teacher encourages us to speak more Chinese.
column9: The pattern is 鼓勵 + person + verb: 鼓勵他繼續努力. It is also a noun: 受到鼓勵, 一種鼓勵. It is the steady support of a teacher or parent; the shout of the moment is 加油.

column3: Gets many people into action for a purpose: 动员群众, 总动员, 动员大会. With a person it means persuading them to take part: 动员他参加. It has an organized, official flavor.
column4: 学校动员大家参加植树活动。
column5: 學校動員大家參加植樹活動。
column6: Xuéxiào dòngyuán dàjiā cānjiā zhíshù huódòng.
column7: The school mobilized everyone to take part in the tree planting.
column9: Gets many people into action for a purpose: 動員群眾, 總動員, 動員大會. With a person it means persuading them to take part: 動員他參加. It has an organized, official flavor.

column3: A firm refusal of a request, an offer or an invitation: 拒绝邀请, 拒绝回答, 被拒绝. It can be followed by a verb. Softer ways to decline are 婉拒 and 谢绝.
column4: 他礼貌地拒绝了我们的邀请。
column5: 他禮貌地拒絕了我們的邀請。
column6: Tā lǐmào de jùjué le wǒmen de yāoqǐng.
column7: He politely declined our invitation.
column9: A firm refusal of a request, an offer or an invitation: 拒絕邀請, 拒絕回答, 被拒絕. It can be followed by a verb. Softer ways to decline are 婉拒 and 謝絕.

column3: Blames someone openly for a fault: 指责别人, 受到指责, 互相指责. 批评 is neutral and can be kind, 责备 is a personal scolding, and 谴责 is a strong, moral condemnation.
column4: 他不应该指责朋友的错误。
column5: 他不應該指責朋友的錯誤。
column6: Tā bù yīnggāi zhǐzé péngyou de cuòwù.
column7: He should not blame his friend for the mistake.
column9: Blames someone openly for a fault: 指責別人, 受到指責, 互相指責. 批評 is neutral and can be kind, 責備 is a personal scolding, and 譴責 is a strong, moral condemnation.

column3: Forces a person to do something against their will: 强迫他做, 被强迫; 强迫症 is OCD. In speech, 逼 is the common word: 别逼我. 强 is read qiǎng, "to force", here and qiáng, "strong", elsewhere.
column4: 没有人可以强迫你做不喜欢的事。
column5: 沒有人可以強迫你做不喜歡的事。
column6: Méiyǒu rén kěyǐ qiǎngpò nǐ zuò bù xǐhuan de shì.
column7: No one can force you to do something you don't like.
column9: Forces a person to do something against their will: 強迫他做, 被強迫; 強迫症 is OCD. In speech, 逼 is the common word: 別逼我. 強 is read qiǎng, "to force", here and qiáng, "strong", elsewhere.

column3: Makes things hard for someone: 别为难他. Or feels in a bind: 很为难, 感到为难, when asked for something you cannot give. 别为难我 is the plea "don't put me on the spot". 为 is read wéi here, but wèi, "for", elsewhere.
column4: 你别为难他，他也是照规定办事。
column5: 你別為難他，他也是照規定辦事。
column6: Nǐ bié wéinán tā, tā yě shì zhào guīdìng bànshì.
column7: Don't make things hard for him; he is just following the rules.
column9: Makes things hard for someone: 別為難他. Or feels in a bind: 很為難, 感到為難, when asked for something you cannot give. 別為難我 is the plea "don't put me on the spot". 為 is read wéi here, but wèi, "for", elsewhere.

column3: The polite formula for interrupting: 打扰一下 to get attention, 打扰了 when leaving, 请勿打扰 on a door sign. The usual reply is 没事 or 不打扰.
column6: Bù hǎoyìsi, dǎrǎo nǐ yīxià.
column7: Sorry, may I bother you for a moment?
column9: The polite formula for interrupting: 打擾一下 to get attention, 打擾了 when leaving, 請勿打擾 on a door sign. The usual reply is 沒事 or 不打擾.

column3: Has the right to decide how something is used: 支配时间, 支配财产, 自由支配. It also means being ruled by a force: 被欲望支配. For sharing out a task, 分配 is the word.
column4: 他可以自由支配自己的时间。
column5: 他可以自由支配自己的時間。
column6: Tā kěyǐ zìyóu zhīpèi zìjǐ de shíjiān.
column7: He can manage his own time freely.
column9: Has the right to decide how something is used: 支配時間, 支配財產, 自由支配. It also means being ruled by a force: 被慾望支配. For sharing out a task, 分配 is the word.

column3: Talks someone into or out of something: 劝+person+verb, as in 劝他别去, 劝你早点睡. It may fail: 劝了半天他也不听. Words around it: 劝告, 劝架, 劝说.
column6: Péngyou quàn wǒ zǎodiǎn xiūxi.
column7: My friend urged me to get to bed early.
column9: Talks someone into or out of something: 勸+person+verb, as in 勸他別去, 勸你早點睡. It may fail: 勸了半天他也不聽. Words around it: 勸告, 勸架, 勸說.

column3: A leader or organization calls on people to act: 号召大家, 发出号召, 响应号召 (answer the call). Formal, from public speeches, school announcements and news. 号 is explained as a mouth 口 with 丂, "exhaled air; a tiger's cry".
column4: 学校号召同学们节约用水。
column5: 學校號召同學們節約用水。
column6: Xuéxiào hàozhào tóngxuémen jiéyuē yòngshuǐ.
column7: The school called on the students to save water.
column9: A leader or organization calls on people to act: 號召大家, 發出號召, 響應號召 (answer the call). Formal, from public speeches, school announcements and news. 號 is explained as a mouth 口 with 丂, "exhaled air; a tiger's cry".

column3: An order from a superior: 下命令, 服从命令, 命令他离开. It is also a verb followed by person and action. In computing it is a command: 命令行. 命 and 令 may both go back to 名, "name": naming, then ordering.
column4: 长官命令士兵立刻出发。
column5: 長官命令士兵立刻出發。
column6: Zhǎngguān mìnglìng shìbīng lìkè chūfā.
column7: The officer ordered the soldiers to set out at once.
column9: An order from a superior: 下命令, 服從命令, 命令他離開. It is also a verb followed by person and action. In computing it is a command: 命令行. 命 and 令 may both go back to 名, "name": naming, then ordering.

column3: Verbal abuse or a harsh scolding: 骂人 is to swear at people, 挨骂 and 被骂 to get yelled at, 骂街 to curse in public. For measured criticism, use 批评.
column4: 他因为迟到被老师骂了。
column5: 他因為遲到被老師罵了。
column6: Tā yīnwèi chídào bèi lǎoshī mà le.
column7: He was scolded by the teacher for being late.
column9: Verbal abuse or a harsh scolding: 罵人 is to swear at people, 挨罵 and 被罵 to get yelled at, 罵街 to curse in public. For measured criticism, use 批評.

column3: A formal 有 for owning big or valuable things, or for qualities: 拥有土地, 拥有财富, 拥有丰富的经验. For small things it sounds odd: say 我有一支笔. In Taiwan, 拥 in this sense is read yǒng.
column4: 这家公司拥有三千名员工。
column5: 這家公司擁有三千名員工。
column6: Zhè jiā gōngsī yōngyǒu sānqiān míng yuángōng.
column7: This company has three thousand employees.
column9: A formal 有 for owning big or valuable things, or for qualities: 擁有土地, 擁有財富, 擁有豐富的經驗. For small things it sounds odd: say 我有一支筆. In Taiwan, 擁 in this sense is read yǒng.

column3: A written 有 for abstract things, usually with a long modifier: 有着悠久的历史, 有着重要的意义, 有着不同的看法. It sounds odd for ordinary objects, where plain 有 is used.
column4: 这座城市有着两千年的历史。
column5: 這座城市有著兩千年的歷史。
column6: Zhè zuò chéngshì yǒuzhe liǎng qiān nián de lìshǐ.
column7: This city has a history of two thousand years.
column9: A written 有 for abstract things, usually with a long modifier: 有著悠久的歷史, 有著重要的意義, 有著不同的看法. It sounds odd for ordinary objects, where plain 有 is used.

column3: Carries a quality or a trace along with it: 带有感情, 带有地方色彩, 带有危险性. The subject is usually a thing, a remark or a style, and the object is a trait.
column4: 他的话带有明显的讽刺意味。
column5: 他的話帶有明顯的諷刺意味。
column6: Tā de huà dàiyǒu míngxiǎn de fěngcì yìwèi.
column7: His words carry an obvious note of sarcasm.
column9: Carries a quality or a trace along with it: 帶有感情, 帶有地方色彩, 帶有危險性. The subject is usually a thing, a remark or a style, and the object is a trait.

column3: Being in a situation or stage, always abstract: 处在困难时期, 正处在发展阶段. 处于 is a more formal equivalent. 处 is read chǔ here, "to be in", and chù, "place", elsewhere.
column4: 这个行业正处在快速发展的阶段。
column5: 這個行業正處在快速發展的階段。
column6: Zhège hángyè zhèng chǔzài kuàisù fāzhǎn de jiēduàn.
column7: This industry is in a stage of rapid development.
column9: Being in a situation or stage, always abstract: 處在困難時期, 正處在發展階段. 處於 is a more formal equivalent. 處 is read chǔ here, "to be in", and chù, "place", elsewhere.

column3: Always points back to something just mentioned, and comes before the verb: 从中学到, 从中受益, 从中选择. The same 中, "among", is in 其中 and 当中.
column4: 我们可以从中学到很多经验。
column5: 我們可以從中學到很多經驗。
column6: Wǒmen kěyǐ cóngzhōng xuédào hěn duō jīngyàn.
column7: We can learn a lot of lessons from it.
column9: Always points back to something just mentioned, and comes before the verb: 從中學到, 從中受益, 從中選擇. The same 中, "among", is in 其中 and 當中.

column3: Says what a fact leads to: 这意味着…, 意味着成功. Not for what a word means, which is 意思. The 着 is neutral and the word almost always has it; 意味 alone is a noun, as in 意味深长.
column4: 学习外语意味着打开新的世界。
column5: 學習外語意味著打開新的世界。
column6: Xuéxí wàiyǔ yìwèizhe dǎkāi xīn de shìjiè.
column7: Learning a foreign language means opening up a new world.
column9: Says what a fact leads to: 這意味著…, 意味著成功. Not for what a word means, which is 意思. The 著 is neutral and the word almost always has it; 意味 alone is a noun, as in 意味深長.

column3: An exception, or being one: 没有例外, 无一例外, 例外情况. 也不例外 follows a statement true of others. To say "except for", use 除外 or 除了.
column4: 每个人都要遵守规定，我也不例外。
column5: 每個人都要遵守規定，我也不例外。
column6: Měi ge rén dōu yào zūnshǒu guīdìng, wǒ yě bù lìwài.
column7: Everyone has to follow the rules, and I am no exception.
column9: An exception, or being one: 沒有例外, 無一例外, 例外情況. 也不例外 follows a statement true of others. To say "except for", use 除外 or 除了.

column3: Mostly spoken. 比方说 introduces an example, like "say" in English. 打比方 means to give an analogy: 打个比方. 比如 is a close equivalent for "for example".
column4: 你打个比方，我就明白了。
column5: 你打個比方，我就明白了。
column6: Nǐ dǎ ge bǐfang, wǒ jiù míngbai le.
column7: Give me an analogy and I will understand.
column9: Mostly spoken. 比方說 introduces an example, like "say" in English. 打比方 means to give an analogy: 打個比方. 比如 is a close equivalent for "for example".

column3: What is left over: 剩下的钱, 只剩下三个, 还剩下多少. 剩下的 means "the rest". 剩 alone forms the food words 剩菜 and 剩饭 (leftovers).
column6: Zhège yuè zhǐ shèngxià jǐ tiān le.
column7: Only a few days are left in this month.
column9: What is left over: 剩下的錢, 只剩下三個, 還剩下多少. 剩下的 means "the rest". 剩 alone forms the food words 剩菜 and 剩飯 (leftovers).

column3: The usual objects are shares and positions rather than things you own: 占有市场, 占有率 (market share). For ordinary owning, 有 is the everyday word; 占有 sounds formal or technical.
column4: 这家公司占有百分之三十的市场。
column5: 這家公司佔有百分之三十的市場。
column6: Zhè jiā gōngsī zhànyǒu bǎi fēn zhī sānshí de shìchǎng.
column7: This company holds thirty percent of the market.
column9: The usual objects are shares and positions rather than things you own: 佔有市場, 佔有率 (market share). For ordinary owning, 有 is the everyday word; 佔有 sounds formal or technical.

column3: Matches things in two sets item for item, as in 一一对应. Before a noun it takes 的: 对应的拼音. 相应 is the one that sits directly before a noun or verb. 应 has two readings: ying4 (to answer) in this word, and ying1 (should).
column4: 每个汉字都有对应的拼音。
column5: 每個漢字都有對應的拼音。
column6: Měi ge Hànzì dōu yǒu duìyìng de pīnyīn.
column7: Every Chinese character has a corresponding pinyin.
column9: Matches things in two sets item for item, as in 一一對應. Before a noun it takes 的: 對應的拼音. 相應 is the one that sits directly before a noun or verb. 應 has two readings: ying4 (to answer) in this word, and ying1 (should).

column3: Nearly always a modifier before a noun or verb (相应措施, 相应下降), rarely a main verb. It says one thing is in line with another that was just mentioned. 相 began as an eye looking at a tree, and was later borrowed for the sense of mutually.
column4: 价格上涨，销量也相应下降。
column5: 價格上漲，銷量也相應下降。
column6: Jiàgé shàngzhǎng, xiāoliàng yě xiāngyìng xiàjiàng.
column7: Prices went up, and sales fell accordingly.
column9: Nearly always a modifier before a noun or verb (相應措施, 相應下降), rarely a main verb. It says one thing is in line with another that was just mentioned. 相 began as an eye looking at a tree, and was later borrowed for the sense of mutually.

column3: Works like an adjective after the subject, with no 很 and no object. To say one thing equals another, use 等于: 二加二等于四.
column6: Zhè liǎng ge shù xiāngděng.
column7: These two numbers are equal.
column9: Works like an adjective after the subject, with no 很 and no object. To say one thing equals another, use 等於: 二加二等於四.

column3: Used as subject or object for the two sides: 彼此了解, 彼此之间. The set reply 彼此彼此 answers a compliment with the same back to you. 此 pictures a foot and a person: where a person stops, here.
column6: Wǒmen bǐcǐ dōu hěn liǎojiě.
column7: We understand each other well.
column9: Used as subject or object for the two sides: 彼此了解, 彼此之間. The set reply 彼此彼此 answers a compliment with the same back to you. 此 pictures a foot and a person: where a person stops, here.

column3: Usually followed by an amount: 只剩一个, 还剩两天. The leftover can be the subject (菜剩了很多), and 剩下 and 剩饭 (leftovers) are the common combinations.
column6: Pánzi lǐ hái shèng yī kuài dàngāo.
column7: One piece of cake is left on the plate.
column9: Usually followed by an amount: 只剩一個, 還剩兩天. The leftover can be the subject (菜剩了很多), and 剩下 and 剩飯 (leftovers) are the common combinations.

column3: Rarely used alone in speech: meet it in 必须, 必要, 必然, 不必 and 未必. Alone before a verb it is formal and means that something will certainly happen. Despite the 心 in it, 必 is probably unrelated to the heart: it is likely a picture of the handle of a weapon.
column6: Tā shuō míngtiān bì dào.
column7: He said he will definitely be here tomorrow.
column9: Rarely used alone in speech: meet it in 必須, 必要, 必然, 不必 and 未必. Alone before a verb it is formal and means that something will certainly happen. Despite the 心 in it, 必 is probably unrelated to the heart: it is likely a picture of the handle of a weapon.

column3: Sounds just like 必须 but takes a noun or ends a clause with 的: 生活必需品, 水是生活必需的. 必须 goes before a verb and means must.
column6: Shuǐ shì shēnghuó bìxū de.
column7: Water is essential for life.
column9: Sounds just like 必須 but takes a noun or ends a clause with 的: 生活必需品, 水是生活必需的. 必須 goes before a verb and means must.

column3: A double negative for what circumstances leave no choice about: 不能不去, 不能不承认. Close to 不得不 (forced to); 不能不 leans toward it would be wrong not to.
column6: Zhè jiàn shì wǒmen bùnéngbù guǎn.
column7: We cannot just ignore this.
column9: A double negative for what circumstances leave no choice about: 不能不去, 不能不承認. Close to 不得不 (forced to); 不能不 leans toward it would be wrong not to.

column3: Spoken. Waves off an offer or a worry: 用不着谢, 用不着你管. The positive is 用得着, and the same V+不着 pattern gives 找不着 and 睡不着.
column4: 这点小事用不着麻烦别人。
column5: 這點小事用不著麻煩別人。
column6: Zhè diǎn xiǎo shì yòngbuzháo máfan biéren.
column7: There is no need to trouble others for such a small matter.
column9: Spoken. Waves off an offer or a worry: 用不著謝, 用不著你管. The positive is 用得著, and the same V+不著 pattern gives 找不著 and 睡不著.

column3: Goes before the verb for an urge you cannot hold back: 忍不住笑, 忍不住哭. The same V+不住 pattern gives 记不住 (can't retain) and 拿不住 (can't hold on to).
column4: 听到这个笑话，大家都忍不住笑了。
column5: 聽到這個笑話，大家都忍不住笑了。
column6: Tīngdào zhège xiàohua, dàjiā dōu rěnbuzhù xiào le.
column7: Hearing the joke, everyone could not help laughing.
column9: Goes before the verb for an urge you cannot hold back: 忍不住笑, 忍不住哭. The same V+不住 pattern gives 記不住 (can't retain) and 拿不住 (can't hold on to).

column3: Spoken. Attachment keeps you from letting go of a person or thing, or from spending or throwing it away: 舍不得你, 舍不得扔. The opposite is 舍得.
column4: 我舍不得扔掉这件旧毛衣。
column5: 我捨不得扔掉這件舊毛衣。
column6: Wǒ shěbude rēngdiào zhè jiàn jiù máoyī.
column7: I can't bear to throw away this old sweater.
column9: Spoken. Attachment keeps you from letting go of a person or thing, or from spending or throwing it away: 捨不得你, 捨不得扔. The opposite is 捨得.

column3: Often a question or a quiet reproach: 你舍得吗？ It also praises generosity: 舍得为孩子花钱. The negative 舍不得 is the form that conveys attachment.
column4: 他舍得为孩子的教育花钱。
column5: 他捨得為孩子的教育花錢。
column6: Tā shěde wèi háizi de jiàoyù huā qián.
column7: He is willing to spend money on his child's education.
column9: Often a question or a quiet reproach: 你捨得嗎？ It also praises generosity: 捨得為孩子花錢. The negative 捨不得 is the form that conveys attachment.

column3: A modest, somewhat formal reply to praise or an honor offered, like a title or the best seat. 过奖了 and 哪里哪里 are the common modest replies, and casual speech uses 哪有 or just 谢谢.
column4: 您过奖了，我真是不敢当。
column5: 您過獎了，我真是不敢當。
column6: Nín guòjiǎng le, wǒ zhēn shì bùgǎndāng.
column7: You flatter me, I really don't deserve it.
column9: A modest, somewhat formal reply to praise or an honor offered, like a title or the best seat. 過獎了 and 哪裡哪裡 are the common modest replies, and casual speech uses 哪有 or just 謝謝.

column3: Spoken. After 得 it adds extremely: 高兴得不得了, 疼得不得了. Alone, 不得了了 cries out that something serious has happened.
column4: 他高兴得不得了，一直在笑。
column5: 他高興得不得了，一直在笑。
column6: Tā gāoxìng de bùdéliǎo, yīzhí zài xiào.
column7: He is so happy that he keeps laughing.
column9: Spoken. After 得 it adds extremely: 高興得不得了, 疼得不得了. Alone, 不得了了 cries out that something serious has happened.

column3: A spoken interjection that cuts someone off or settles a matter, often a little annoyed or resigned. 得了吧 is the sharper come on, I don't believe it.
column4: 得了，别说了，我已经知道了。
column5: 得了，別說了，我已經知道了。
column6: Déle, bié shuō le, wǒ yǐjīng zhīdào le.
column7: All right, stop talking, I already know.
column9: A spoken interjection that cuts someone off or settles a matter, often a little annoyed or resigned. 得了吧 is the sharper come on, I don't believe it.

column3: A spoken cry of dismay when something has gone wrong: 完了！ and 这下完了. In a plain statement it only reports completion: 说完了, 吃完了.
column4: 糟了，我把钥匙忘在家里了，完了！
column5: 糟了，我把鑰匙忘在家裡了，完了！
column6: Zāo le, wǒ bǎ yàoshi wàng zài jiālǐ le, wánle!
column7: Oh no, I forgot my keys at home, I'm done for!
column9: A spoken cry of dismay when something has gone wrong: 完了！ and 這下完了. In a plain statement it only reports completion: 說完了, 吃完了.

column3: Takes the thing that is brushed aside: 不顾危险, 不顾反对. It sounds bold or reckless, and 不顾一切 means at all costs.
column4: 他不顾危险，跳进水里救人。
column5: 他不顧危險，跳進水裡救人。
column6: Tā bùgù wēixiǎn, tiàojìn shuǐ lǐ jiù rén.
column7: Disregarding the danger, he jumped into the water to save someone.
column9: Takes the thing that is brushed aside: 不顧危險, 不顧反對. It sounds bold or reckless, and 不顧一切 means at all costs.

column3: A written link: the clause after it is the result or aim of the action before it, with the same subject (采取措施，从而提高效率). Rare in speech.
column4: 他每天锻炼，从而保持了健康。
column5: 他每天鍛鍊，從而保持了健康。
column6: Tā měi tiān duànliàn, cóng'ér bǎochí le jiànkāng.
column7: He exercises every day and so stays healthy.
column9: A written link: the clause after it is the result or aim of the action before it, with the same subject (採取措施，從而提高效率). Rare in speech.

column3: A written word for so, placed after the cause is stated. In speech people say 所以, which pairs with 因为; 因而 stands comfortably on its own.
column4: 天气很冷，因而路上的人很少。
column5: 天氣很冷，因而路上的人很少。
column6: Tiānqì hěn lěng, yīn'ér lùshàng de rén hěn shǎo.
column7: It was very cold, so there were few people on the road.
column9: A written word for so, placed after the cause is stated. In speech people say 所以, which pairs with 因為; 因而 stands comfortably on its own.

column3: Introduces the purpose of what was just said, so it opens the second clause. 为了 goes before the action; 以便 comes after it, and is more formal.
column4: 请留下电话号码，以便我们联系你。
column5: 請留下電話號碼，以便我們聯繫你。
column6: Qǐng liúxià diànhuà hàomǎ, yǐbiàn wǒmen liánxì nǐ.
column7: Please leave a phone number so that we can contact you.
column9: Introduces the purpose of what was just said, so it opens the second clause. 為了 goes before the action; 以便 comes after it, and is more formal.

column3: A formal link that starts a conclusion from what was just said: 由此可见, 由此看来. It belongs to writing and speeches rather than chat.
column4: 他每天练习，由此可见他很努力。
column5: 他每天練習，由此可見他很努力。
column6: Tā měi tiān liànxí, yóucǐ kějiàn tā hěn nǔlì.
column7: He practices every day, which shows he works hard.
column9: A formal link that starts a conclusion from what was just said: 由此可見, 由此看來. It belongs to writing and speeches rather than chat.

column3: Written for so or like this, standing for what was just described: 如此重要, 事实如此, 如此而已 (that is all). The spoken counterpart is 这样.
column4: 他如此努力，一定会成功。
column5: 他如此努力，一定會成功。
column6: Tā rúcǐ nǔlì, yīdìng huì chénggōng.
column7: He works so hard that he is sure to succeed.
column9: Written for so or like this, standing for what was just described: 如此重要, 事實如此, 如此而已 (that is all). The spoken counterpart is 這樣.

column3: Written for like, in a comparison: 如同亲姐姐一样. The clause often ends in 一样 or 一般. In speech people say 像 or 好像 instead.
column4: 她对我如同亲姐姐一样。
column5: 她對我如同親姐姐一樣。
column6: Tā duì wǒ rútóng qīn jiějie yīyàng.
column7: She treats me just like a real older sister.
column9: Written for like, in a comparison: 如同親姐姐一樣. The clause often ends in 一樣 or 一般. In speech people say 像 or 好像 instead.

column3: Ends the clause that announces what comes next, with a colon after it: 内容如下, 具体安排如下. Typical of notices, emails and reports.
column4: 会议时间和地点如下：周五下午三点，二楼会议室。
column5: 會議時間和地點如下：週五下午三點，二樓會議室。
column6: Huìyì shíjiān hé dìdiǎn rúxià: zhōuwǔ xiàwǔ sān diǎn, èr lóu huìyìshì.
column7: The time and place of the meeting are as follows: Friday at three p.m., conference room on the second floor.
column9: Ends the clause that announces what comes next, with a colon after it: 內容如下, 具體安排如下. Typical of notices, emails and reports.

column3: Opens a sentence in the frame 正如 + someone + 所说: 正如你所说, 正如大家所知. The main clause then says the same holds here.
column4: 正如你所说，学习需要耐心。
column5: 正如你所說，學習需要耐心。
column6: Zhèngrú nǐ suǒ shuō, xuéxí xūyào nàixīn.
column7: Just as you said, learning takes patience.
column9: Opens a sentence in the frame 正如 + someone + 所說: 正如你所說, 正如大家所知. The main clause then says the same holds here.

column3: Opens a sentence with a change that comes with another: 随着时间的推移, 随着经济的发展. It follows a process, not a person; for following a person use 跟着.
column4: 随着生活水平的提高，人们越来越注意健康。
column5: 隨著生活水平的提高，人們越來越注意健康。
column6: Suízhe shēnghuó shuǐpíng de tígāo, rénmen yuè lái yuè zhùyì jiànkāng.
column7: As living standards rise, people pay more and more attention to health.
column9: Opens a sentence with a change that comes with another: 隨著時間的推移, 隨著經濟的發展. It follows a process, not a person; for following a person use 跟著.

column3: Followed by the motive, then the action: 出于好心, 出于礼貌, 出于安全考虑. It is written, and names an inner reason; plain 因为 is the spoken cause.
column6: Tā chūyú lǐmào, méiyǒu jùjué.
column7: Out of politeness, he did not refuse.
column9: Followed by the motive, then the action: 出於好心, 出於禮貌, 出於安全考慮. It is written, and names an inner reason; plain 因為 is the spoken cause.

column3: Both a verb (依据法律) and a noun (没有依据, 科学依据). A formal sibling of 根据, common in law, science and reports.
column4: 法官依据法律作出了判决。
column5: 法官依據法律作出了判決。
column6: Fǎguān yījù fǎlǜ zuòchū le pànjué.
column7: The judge made the ruling on the basis of the law.
column9: Both a verb (依據法律) and a noun (沒有依據, 科學依據). A formal sibling of 根據, common in law, science and reports.

column3: Followed by a rule, plan or instruction: 依照规定, 依照说明书. Close to 按照 but more formal, so it fits regulations and manuals.
column6: Qǐng yīzhào shuōmíngshū ānzhuāng.
column7: Please install it in accordance with the instructions.
column9: Followed by a rule, plan or instruction: 依照規定, 依照說明書. Close to 按照 but more formal, so it fits regulations and manuals.

column3: Before a verb for on the basis of: 凭票入场, 凭本事吃饭. 凭什么？ asks on what grounds, and is how people protest something unfair. It also appears in 文凭 (diploma).
column6: Jǐngqū píng piào rùchǎng.
column7: Entry to the scenic area is by ticket.
