column9: Before a verb for on the basis of: 憑票入場, 憑本事吃飯. 憑什麼？ asks on what grounds, and is how people protest something unfair. It also appears in 文憑 (diploma).

column3: Sits in the frame 以…为主, with the main part between 以 and 为主: 以中餐为主, 以学习为主. It can also modify a noun: 以中餐为主的菜单.
column4: 我们公司的客户以年轻人为主。
column5: 我們公司的客戶以年輕人為主。
column6: Wǒmen gōngsī de kèhù yǐ niánqīngrén wéizhǔ.
column7: Our company's customers are mainly young people.
column9: Sits in the frame 以…為主, with the main part between 以 and 為主: 以中餐為主, 以學習為主. It can also modify a noun: 以中餐為主的菜單.

column3: Closes a time phrase and marks the end point: 到目前为止, 到今天为止. The set phrase 点到为止 means to touch on something and stop there.
column4: 到目前为止，我已经学了五百个汉字。
column5: 到目前為止，我已經學了五百個漢字。
column6: Dào mùqián wéizhǐ, wǒ yǐjīng xué le wǔbǎi ge Hànzì.
column7: Up to now, I have learned five hundred characters.
column9: Closes a time phrase and marks the end point: 到目前為止, 到今天為止. The set phrase 點到為止 means to touch on something and stop there.

column3: Followed by the length of a planned event: 为期三天, 为期一年的课程. Formal, and typical of announcements and news.
column6: Zhè cì péixùn wéiqī yī zhōu.
column7: This training lasts one week.
column9: Followed by the length of a planned event: 為期三天, 為期一年的課程. Formal, and typical of announcements and news.

column3: Followed by a field or purpose noun, saying what a thing is for: 用于教学, 用于建筑. It is written; 用来 + a verb is the spoken counterpart.
column4: 这种材料主要用于建筑。
column5: 這種材料主要用於建築。
column6: Zhè zhǒng cáiliào zhǔyào yòngyú jiànzhù.
column7: This material is mainly used in construction.
column9: Followed by a field or purpose noun, saying what a thing is for: 用於教學, 用於建築. It is written; 用來 + a verb is the spoken counterpart.

column3: Followed by a verb: 用来写字, 用来切肉. It often comes in the frame 是用来…的. When a noun follows, use 用于 instead.
column4: 这把刀是用来切水果的。
column5: 這把刀是用來切水果的。
column6: Zhè bǎ dāo shì yònglái qiē shuǐguǒ de.
column7: This knife is used for cutting fruit.
column9: Followed by a verb: 用來寫字, 用來切肉. It often comes in the frame 是用來…的. When a noun follows, use 用於 instead.

column3: Followed by a verb, to say what a thing makes easy: 便于携带, 便于管理. Formal, typical of product descriptions. One old dictionary explains 便 as a person changing posture to make himself comfortable.
column6: Zhè zhǒng bāo hěn qīng, biànyú xiédài.
column7: This kind of bag is light and easy to carry.
column9: Followed by a verb, to say what a thing makes easy: 便於攜帶, 便於管理. Formal, typical of product descriptions. One old dictionary explains 便 as a person changing posture to make himself comfortable.

column3: Followed by what benefits: a noun or a verb phrase (有利于健康, 有利于发展). The opposite is 不利于. Formal; speech says 对…有好处. 利 shows grain 禾 and a knife 刀: to reap grain with a knife.
column4: 多喝水有利于身体健康。
column5: 多喝水有利於身體健康。
column6: Duō hē shuǐ yǒulìyú shēntǐ jiànkāng.
column7: Drinking more water is good for your health.
column9: Followed by what benefits: a noun or a verb phrase (有利於健康, 有利於發展). The opposite is 不利於. Formal; speech says 對…有好處. 利 shows grain 禾 and a knife 刀: to reap grain with a knife.

column3: A person's motive, in serious talk or law: 学习动机, 犯罪动机, 动机不纯. It is not a motor; that is 发动机 or 马达.
column4: 他的动机是想帮助别人。
column5: 他的動機是想幫助別人。
column6: Tā de dòngjī shì xiǎng bāngzhù biéren.
column7: His motive was to help others.
column9: A person's motive, in serious talk or law: 學習動機, 犯罪動機, 動機不純. It is not a motor; that is 發動機 or 馬達.

column3: Written, before a verb, often hinting the attempt did not work: 试图逃跑, 试图说服. In speech people say 想 or 想办法.
column4: 他试图说服父母，但没有成功。
column5: 他試圖說服父母，但沒有成功。
column6: Tā shìtú shuōfú fùmǔ, dàn méiyǒu chénggōng.
column7: He tried to persuade his parents but did not succeed.
column9: Written, before a verb, often hinting the attempt did not work: 試圖逃跑, 試圖說服. In speech people say 想 or 想辦法.

column3: Both noun and verb, for planning on a larger, longer scale: 城市规划, 职业规划, 规划未来. 计划 is the everyday plan, and 规划 the systematic one.
column4: 他正在认真规划自己的未来。
column5: 他正在認真規劃自己的未來。
column6: Tā zhèngzài rènzhēn guīhuà zìjǐ de wèilái.
column7: He is carefully planning his future.
column9: Both noun and verb, for planning on a larger, longer scale: 城市規劃, 職業規劃, 規劃未來. 計劃 is the everyday plan, and 規劃 the systematic one.

column3: A formal seek for abstract things you want: 寻求帮助, 寻求答案, 寻求支持. For a physical object, say 找 or 寻找.
column4: 遇到困难时，要学会寻求帮助。
column5: 遇到困難時，要學會尋求幫助。
column6: Yùdào kùnnan shí, yào xuéhuì xúnqiú bāngzhù.
column7: When you run into difficulty, you should learn to ask for help.
column9: A formal seek for abstract things you want: 尋求幫助, 尋求答案, 尋求支持. For a physical object, say 找 or 尋找.

column3: A way of reaching a goal. It is neutral in 技术手段, but can be underhanded in 不择手段 (by any means) and 耍手段 (play tricks).
column4: 他想用别的手段解决问题。
column5: 他想用別的手段解決問題。
column6: Tā xiǎng yòng bié de shǒuduàn jiějué wèntí.
column7: He wants to solve the problem by other means.
column9: A way of reaching a goal. It is neutral in 技術手段, but can be underhanded in 不擇手段 (by any means) and 耍手段 (play tricks).

column3: The characteristic technique of an artist, writer or performer, or a criminal: 艺术手法, 作案手法. It is about style and manner, where 手段 is about means.
column4: 这位作家的写作手法很特别。
column5: 這位作家的寫作手法很特別。
column6: Zhè wèi zuòjiā de xiězuò shǒufǎ hěn tèbié.
column7: This writer's way of writing is very distinctive.
column9: The characteristic technique of an artist, writer or performer, or a criminal: 藝術手法, 作案手法. It is about style and manner, where 手段 is about means.

column3: Both verb and noun, for getting past a limit: 突破纪录, 突破难关, 取得突破 (make a breakthrough). An old dictionary explains 突 as a dog suddenly coming out of a den.
column4: 这位运动员突破了世界纪录。
column5: 這位運動員突破了世界紀錄。
column6: Zhè wèi yùndòngyuán tūpò le shìjiè jìlù.
column7: This athlete broke the world record.
column9: Both verb and noun, for getting past a limit: 突破紀錄, 突破難關, 取得突破 (make a breakthrough). An old dictionary explains 突 as a dog suddenly coming out of a den.

column3: Surpassing a rival, a limit or your past self: 超越自我, 超越极限. More figurative and grander than 超过, which handles plain numbers and speed.
column4: 他每天都在努力超越昨天的自己。
column5: 他每天都在努力超越昨天的自己。
column6: Tā měi tiān dōu zài nǔlì chāoyuè zuótiān de zìjǐ.
column7: Every day he works hard to surpass his self of yesterday.
column9: Surpassing a rival, a limit or your past self: 超越自我, 超越極限. More figurative and grander than 超過, which handles plain numbers and speed.

column3: Starts a machine, program or project: 启动电脑, 启动项目, 启动仪式. It names the moment of launch, after which the thing keeps running. One scholar reads 启 as opening a door with the hand.
column4: 我按了一下按钮，机器就启动了。
column5: 我按了一下按鈕，機器就啟動了。
column6: Wǒ àn le yīxià ànniǔ, jīqì jiù qǐdòng le.
column7: I pressed the button and the machine started up.
column9: Starts a machine, program or project: 啟動電腦, 啟動項目, 啟動儀式. It names the moment of launch, after which the thing keeps running. One scholar reads 啟 as opening a door with the hand.

column3: Turns a plan, policy or duty into real action and pins down the details: 落实政策, 落实责任, 还没落实 (not settled yet). Typical of official and work talk.
column4: 这个计划还需要具体落实。
column5: 這個計畫還需要具體落實。
column6: Zhège jìhuà hái xūyào jùtǐ luòshí.
column7: This plan still needs to be carried out in concrete terms.
column9: Turns a plan, policy or duty into real action and pins down the details: 落實政策, 落實責任, 還沒落實 (not settled yet). Typical of official and work talk.

column3: Fixes something formal and lasting: 确立目标, 确立地位, 确立关系. 建立 creates something new (建立公司), while 确立 fixes or confirms it firmly. 立 began as a picture of a person standing on the ground.
column4: 我们已经确立了今年的目标。
column5: 我們已經確立了今年的目標。
column6: Wǒmen yǐjīng quèlì le jīnnián de mùbiāo.
column7: We have already established this year's goals.
column9: Fixes something formal and lasting: 確立目標, 確立地位, 確立關係. 建立 creates something new (建立公司), while 確立 fixes or confirms it firmly. 立 began as a picture of a person standing on the ground.

column3: Keeps something within bounds: emotions, weight, spread, a machine. 控制情绪, 控制体重; 失去控制 is to lose control, and 控制不住 is to be unable to hold back.
column4: 他努力控制自己的情绪。
column5: 他努力控制自己的情緒。
column6: Tā nǔlì kòngzhì zìjǐ de qíngxù.
column7: He tries hard to control his emotions.
column9: Keeps something within bounds: emotions, weight, spread, a machine. 控制情緒, 控制體重; 失去控制 is to lose control, and 控制不住 is to be unable to hold back.

column3: Almost always followed by 作用 or 效果, with a describing word between: 起到重要作用, 起到了很好的效果. It belongs to reports and news; 发挥作用 is a close alternative.
column4: 这些措施起到了很好的作用。
column5: 這些措施起到了很好的作用。
column6: Zhèxiē cuòshī qǐdào le hěn hǎo de zuòyòng.
column7: These measures played a very good role.
column9: Almost always followed by 作用 or 效果, with a describing word between: 起到重要作用, 起到了很好的效果. It belongs to reports and news; 發揮作用 is a close alternative.

column3: Formal, about results and figures. As a verb it takes the thing expected: 预期增长. As a noun it pairs with 达到, 超出 and 低于: 达到预期 meets expectations, 低于预期 falls short.
column4: 这次活动的效果超出了我们的预期。
column5: 這次活動的效果超出了我們的預期。
column6: Zhè cì huódòng de xiàoguǒ chāochū le wǒmen de yùqī.
column7: The result of this event exceeded our expectations.
column9: Formal, about results and figures. As a verb it takes the thing expected: 預期增長. As a noun it pairs with 達到, 超出 and 低於: 達到預期 meets expectations, 低於預期 falls short.

column3: Fits new methods, approaches and experiments: 尝试新方法, 勇于尝试. It is also a noun, an attempt: 第一次尝试. For trying on clothes say 试穿.
column4: 我想尝试一种新的学习方法。
column5: 我想嘗試一種新的學習方法。
column6: Wǒ xiǎng chángshì yī zhǒng xīn de xuéxí fāngfǎ.
column7: I want to try a new way of studying.
column9: Fits new methods, approaches and experiments: 嘗試新方法, 勇於嘗試. It is also a noun, an attempt: 第一次嘗試. For trying on clothes say 試穿.

column3: Both a noun and an adjective: 关键在于… introduces what a result hinges on, and 关键时刻 and 关键问题 are set phrases. The 键 is also the key of a keyboard, as in 键盘 and 按键. 关 in its bronze-inscription form pictures a door locked with two wooden sticks.
column4: 学好语言的关键在于多练习。
column5: 學好語言的關鍵在於多練習。
column6: Xuéhǎo yǔyán de guānjiàn zàiyú duō liànxí.
column7: The key to learning a language well lies in practicing a lot.
column9: Both a noun and an adjective: 關鍵在於… introduces what a result hinges on, and 關鍵時刻 and 關鍵問題 are set phrases. The 鍵 is also the key of a keyboard, as in 鍵盤 and 按鍵. 關 in its bronze-inscription form pictures a door locked with two wooden sticks.

column3: One step or link in a process that depends on the others: 每个环节, 关键环节, and 薄弱环节 for the weak link. Common in writing about production, management and policy.
column4: 生产的每一个环节都要检查。
column5: 生產的每一個環節都要檢查。
column6: Shēngchǎn de měi yī ge huánjié dōu yào jiǎnchá.
column7: Every stage of production has to be checked.
column9: One step or link in a process that depends on the others: 每個環節, 關鍵環節, and 薄弱環節 for the weak link. Common in writing about production, management and policy.

column3: Usually in the frame 在…的前提下, with the condition inside: 在保证安全的前提下. Also 前提是… for the condition, and 前提条件 for a prerequisite. 前 was first written with a foot and a boat: a foot on a boat moving forward.
column4: 在保证安全的前提下，我们可以开始工作。
column5: 在保證安全的前提下，我們可以開始工作。
column6: Zài bǎozhèng ānquán de qiántí xià, wǒmen kěyǐ kāishǐ gōngzuò.
column7: On condition that safety is ensured, we can start work.
column9: Usually in the frame 在…的前提下, with the condition inside: 在保證安全的前提下. Also 前提是… for the condition, and 前提條件 for a prerequisite. 前 was first written with a foot and a boat: a foot on a boat moving forward.

column3: The outlook of an industry, market or project: 发展前景, 市场前景, with 好, 广阔 or 不乐观 after it. For a person's own future use 前途. It is also the foreground of a picture, opposite 背景.
column4: 这个行业的发展前景很好。
column5: 這個行業的發展前景很好。
column6: Zhège hángyè de fāzhǎn qiánjǐng hěn hǎo.
column7: The prospects for this industry are very good.
column9: The outlook of an industry, market or project: 發展前景, 市場前景, with 好, 廣闊 or 不樂觀 after it. For a person's own future use 前途. It is also the foreground of a picture, opposite 背景.

column3: A written outline with headings: 教学大纲 for a course, 写作大纲 for an essay, and 考试大纲 for what an exam covers. For the gist of a text, 大意 is the word. 纲 itself is the head rope of a fishing net and also a guiding principle.
column4: 写文章之前，先列一个大纲。
column5: 寫文章之前，先列一個大綱。
column6: Xiě wénzhāng zhīqián, xiān liè yī ge dàgāng.
column7: Before you write an article, first draw up an outline.
column9: A written outline with headings: 教學大綱 for a course, 寫作大綱 for an essay, and 考試大綱 for what an exam covers. For the gist of a text, 大意 is the word. 綱 itself is the head rope of a fishing net and also a guiding principle.

column3: A fixed way of working or arranging things: 工作模式, 商业模式, 思维模式. It is also a setting on a device: 飞行模式, 静音模式.
column6: Shǒujī jìnrù le fēixíng móshì.
column7: The phone has gone into airplane mode.
column9: A fixed way of working or arranging things: 工作模式, 商業模式, 思維模式. It is also a setting on a device: 飛行模式, 靜音模式.

column3: How a system works, for organizations, rules and processes rather than a physical machine (that is 机器): 市场机制, 运行机制, 激励机制. 机 is the machine in 飞机 and 手机, and 制 is the system in 制度.
column4: 学校建立了新的奖励机制。
column5: 學校建立了新的獎勵機制。
column6: Xuéxiào jiànlì le xīn de jiǎnglì jīzhì.
column7: The school set up a new reward scheme.
column9: How a system works, for organizations, rules and processes rather than a physical machine (that is 機器): 市場機制, 運行機制, 激勵機制. 機 is the machine in 飛機 and 手機, and 制 is the system in 制度.

column3: The overall state of affairs at one moment, often tense or decisive: 僵持的局面, 控制局面, 打开局面. It is bigger and more dynamic than 情况. 局 also counts games, as in 一局 and 棋局.
column4: 双方的比赛出现了僵持的局面。
column5: 雙方的比賽出現了僵持的局面。
column6: Shuāngfāng de bǐsài chūxiàn le jiāngchí de júmiàn.
column7: The match between the two sides reached a stalemate.
column9: The overall state of affairs at one moment, often tense or decisive: 僵持的局面, 控制局面, 打開局面. It is bigger and more dynamic than 情況. 局 also counts games, as in 一局 and 棋局.

column3: What an event looks like as it plays out before you: 热闹的场面, 感人的场面, and 大场面 for a grand occasion. 场面话 are polite words said only to keep up appearances. Compare 局面, the state of affairs.
column4: 婚礼上的场面非常感人。
column5: 婚禮上的場面非常感人。
column6: Hūnlǐ shàng de chǎngmiàn fēicháng gǎnrén.
column7: The scene at the wedding was very moving.
column9: What an event looks like as it plays out before you: 熱鬧的場面, 感人的場面, and 大場面 for a grand occasion. 場面話 are polite words said only to keep up appearances. Compare 局面, the state of affairs.

column3: Circumstances in a particular case, a little more written than 情况: 这种情形, 在这种情形下, 当时的情形.
column4: 在这种情形下，你最好别说话。
column5: 在這種情形下，你最好別說話。
column6: Zài zhè zhǒng qíngxing xià, nǐ zuìhǎo bié shuōhuà.
column7: In a situation like this, it is best that you say nothing.
column9: Circumstances in a particular case, a little more written than 情況: 這種情形, 在這種情形下, 當時的情形.

column3: The form something takes, in science and abstract talk: 物质形态, 语言形态, and 意识形态 for ideology. 态 is the state in 固态, 液态, 气态 and 状态.
column4: 水有三种形态：固态、液态和气态。
column5: 水有三種形態：固態、液態和氣態。
column6: Shuǐ yǒu sān zhǒng xíngtài: gùtài, yètài hé qìtài.
column7: Water has three forms: solid, liquid and gas.
column9: The form something takes, in science and abstract talk: 物質形態, 語言形態, and 意識形態 for ideology. 態 is the state in 固態, 液態, 氣態 and 狀態.

column3: Levels or layers, and the order of ideas in a text: 层次分明 praises clear structure, 有层次 says something is well layered, and 不同层次 means different levels. 层 also counts floors, as in 三层.
column4: 这篇文章写得层次分明。
column5: 這篇文章寫得層次分明。
column6: Zhè piān wénzhāng xiě de céngcì fēnmíng.
column7: This article is written with a clear structure.
column9: Levels or layers, and the order of ideas in a text: 層次分明 praises clear structure, 有層次 says something is well layered, and 不同層次 means different levels. 層 also counts floors, as in 三層.

column3: Added to the end of a word to say it is that kind of thing: 中式, 西式, 日式 (Chinese, Western, Japanese style), 老式 old-fashioned. It sits inside 公式 formula, 仪式 ceremony and 方式 way.
column4: 我喜欢中式的装修风格。
column5: 我喜歡中式的裝修風格。
column6: Wǒ xǐhuan zhōng shì de zhuāngxiū fēnggé.
column7: I like the Chinese style of decoration.
column9: Added to the end of a word to say it is that kind of thing: 中式, 西式, 日式 (Chinese, Western, Japanese style), 老式 old-fashioned. It sits inside 公式 formula, 儀式 ceremony and 方式 way.

column3: Alone it is mostly the cry 糟了, uh-oh, or 很糟 for a bad situation: 情况很糟. In 乱七八糟 and 糟糕 it carries the sense of a mess. The rice part of 糟 perhaps refers to liquor made from fermented rice.
column6: Zāo le, wǒ wàng le dài yàoshi.
column7: Oh no, I forgot to bring my keys.
column9: Alone it is mostly the cry 糟了, uh-oh, or 很糟 for a bad situation: 情況很糟. In 亂七八糟 and 糟糕 it carries the sense of a mess. The rice part of 糟 perhaps refers to liquor made from fermented rice.

column3: Both a description and an oh-no reaction, in speech and writing: 糟糕的天气, 真糟糕, and 糟糕，迟到了！ Though 糕 is the cake in 蛋糕, it carries no cake meaning here; the pair is a fixed word.
column6: Jīntiān de tiānqì zāogāo jíle.
column7: The weather today is awful.
column9: Both a description and an oh-no reaction, in speech and writing: 糟糕的天氣, 真糟糕, and 糟糕，遲到了！ Though 糕 is the cake in 蛋糕, it carries no cake meaning here; the pair is a fixed word.

column3: A flaw to be exploited or fixed: 法律漏洞, 税收漏洞, and 系统漏洞 for a software security hole. 钻漏洞 is to exploit a loophole and 堵住漏洞 to close it. 漏 alone is to leak (漏水) or leave out.
column4: 这个系统有一个安全漏洞。
column5: 這個系統有一個安全漏洞。
column6: Zhège xìtǒng yǒu yī ge ānquán lòudòng.
column7: This system has a security hole.
column9: A flaw to be exploited or fixed: 法律漏洞, 稅收漏洞, and 系統漏洞 for a software security hole. 鑽漏洞 is to exploit a loophole and 堵住漏洞 to close it. 漏 alone is to leak (漏水) or leave out.

column3: A slip made while carrying out a task, with no blame for bad intent: 操作失误, 工作失误, 判断失误. In sports it is an unforced error. Milder than 错误, which can be plain wrong or morally wrong.
column4: 一个小失误让他们输掉了比赛。
column5: 一個小失誤讓他們輸掉了比賽。
column6: Yī ge xiǎo shīwù ràng tāmen shūdiào le bǐsài.
column7: One small slip made them lose the match.
column9: A slip made while carrying out a task, with no blame for bad intent: 操作失誤, 工作失誤, 判斷失誤. In sports it is an unforced error. Milder than 錯誤, which can be plain wrong or morally wrong.

column3: A written word for lacking something abstract that is needed: 缺乏经验, 缺乏信心, 缺乏资金. In everyday speech people say 缺 or 没有 instead: 缺钱.
column6: Tā quēfá gōngzuò jīngyàn.
column7: He lacks work experience.
column9: A written word for lacking something abstract that is needed: 缺乏經驗, 缺乏信心, 缺乏資金. In everyday speech people say 缺 or 沒有 instead: 缺錢.

column3: Formal. Hinders progress or movement: 阻碍发展, 阻碍交通. As a noun it is an obstacle you meet: 成为阻碍. 阻 turns up in 阻止 and 阻力, and 碍 in 妨碍 and 障碍.
column6: Dàxuě zǔ'ài le jiāotōng.
column7: The heavy snow obstructed traffic.
column9: Formal. Hinders progress or movement: 阻礙發展, 阻礙交通. As a noun it is an obstacle you meet: 成為阻礙. 阻 turns up in 阻止 and 阻力, and 礙 in 妨礙 and 障礙.

column3: A problem that keeps bothering someone: 被问题困扰, 失眠困扰着他. As a noun it is a polite way to apologize: 给您带来困扰了, sorry for the trouble.
column6: Shīmián yīzhí kùnrǎo zhe tā.
column7: Insomnia has troubled him all along.
column9: A problem that keeps bothering someone: 被問題困擾, 失眠困擾著他. As a noun it is a polite way to apologize: 給您帶來困擾了, sorry for the trouble.

column3: Follows what is lacking: 经验不足, 资金不足. As a noun it politely names weak points: 存在不足, 弥补不足. Before a number it means fewer than: 不足十人.
column4: 这个项目的资金还不足。
column5: 這個項目的資金還不足。
column6: Zhège xiàngmù de zījīn hái bùzú.
column7: This project does not have enough funds yet.
column9: Follows what is lacking: 經驗不足, 資金不足. As a noun it politely names weak points: 存在不足, 彌補不足. Before a number it means fewer than: 不足十人.

column3: Usually in 对…不利, bad for someone or something, or before a noun: 不利条件, 不利因素. The opposite is 有利. In casual speech 对…不好 says the same.
column6: Áoyè duì shēntǐ bùlì.
column7: Staying up late is bad for your health.
column9: Usually in 對…不利, bad for someone or something, or before a noun: 不利條件, 不利因素. The opposite is 有利. In casual speech 對…不好 says the same.

column3: Harm to something valuable that is not a physical object: 损害健康, 损害名誉, 损害利益. For a broken object the word is 损坏. It is also a noun, the harm done.
column6: Áoyè huì sǔnhài nǐ de jiànkāng.
column7: Staying up late harms your health.
column9: Harm to something valuable that is not a physical object: 損害健康, 損害名譽, 損害利益. For a broken object the word is 損壞. It is also a noun, the harm done.

column3: A noun for a loss of money, goods or time, and a verb too: 造成损失, 经济损失, 损失了很多钱. For losing a match say 输, and for misplacing something say 丢.
column4: 这场大火造成了巨大的损失。
column5: 這場大火造成了巨大的損失。
column6: Zhè chǎng dàhuǒ zàochéng le jùdà de sǔnshī.
column7: This big fire caused huge losses.
column9: A noun for a loss of money, goods or time, and a verb too: 造成損失, 經濟損失, 損失了很多錢. For losing a match say 輸, and for misplacing something say 丟.

column3: As a verb it takes a person: 害人, 害了他. 害得 brings in the bad result: 害得他丢了工作. In 害怕 and 害羞 it is a feeling of fear or shyness, and 害虫 is a pest.
column4: 这件事害得他丢了工作。
column5: 這件事害得他丟了工作。
column6: Zhè jiàn shì hài de tā diū le gōngzuò.
column7: This matter cost him his job.
column9: As a verb it takes a person: 害人, 害了他. 害得 brings in the bad result: 害得他丟了工作. In 害怕 and 害羞 it is a feeling of fear or shyness, and 害蟲 is a pest.

column3: An everyday word of praise: 真棒, 太棒了, 唱得很棒. As a noun it is a stick, as in 棒球 and 木棒. The character is a wooden club, and the sense excellent may have developed from stick to hard to excellent.
column6: Nǐ jīntiān de biǎoxiàn zhēn bàng!
column7: You did really great today!
column9: An everyday word of praise: 真棒, 太棒了, 唱得很棒. As a noun it is a stick, as in 棒球 and 木棒. The character is a wooden club, and the sense excellent may have developed from stick to hard to excellent.

column3: A rank, used before a noun or after 是…的: 一流大学, 世界一流, 服务是一流的. 二流 and 三流 are the lower grades, and 三流 is dismissive.
column4: 这家餐厅的服务是一流的。
column5: 這家餐廳的服務是一流的。
column6: Zhè jiā cāntīng de fúwù shì yīliú de.
column7: The service at this restaurant is first-class.
column9: A rank, used before a noun or after 是…的: 一流大學, 世界一流, 服務是一流的. 二流 and 三流 are the lower grades, and 三流 is dismissive.

column3: Describes what is rare or deeply valued for its history or feeling: 珍贵的礼物, 珍贵文物, 珍贵的回忆. It is about worth, not price: a gift is 珍贵 but a price is 贵. 珍 first meant a gemstone and then also came to mean rare.
column4: 这张照片对我来说非常珍贵。
column5: 這張照片對我來說非常珍貴。
column6: Zhè zhāng zhàopiàn duì wǒ lái shuō fēicháng zhēnguì.
column7: This photo is very precious to me.
column9: Describes what is rare or deeply valued for its history or feeling: 珍貴的禮物, 珍貴文物, 珍貴的回憶. It is about worth, not price: a gift is 珍貴 but a price is 貴. 珍 first meant a gemstone and then also came to mean rare.

column3: Takes something you have and do not want to waste: 珍惜时间, 珍惜机会, 珍惜友谊. 珍贵 describes the thing, while 珍惜 is what you do about it. In Taiwan, 惜 is read xí instead of xī.
column4: 我们要珍惜现在拥有的一切。
column5: 我們要珍惜現在擁有的一切。
column6: Wǒmen yào zhēnxī xiànzài yōngyǒu de yīqiè.
column7: We should cherish everything we have now.
column9: Takes something you have and do not want to waste: 珍惜時間, 珍惜機會, 珍惜友誼. 珍貴 describes the thing, while 珍惜 is what you do about it. In Taiwan, 惜 is read xí instead of xī.

column3: A pearl: 一颗珍珠 "a pearl", 珍珠项链 "pearl necklace", 珍珠奶茶 "bubble tea". Both characters have 王 on the left, where 王 is the form of 玉 jade in compounds, a sign that they are gems. Taiwan's bubble tea is called 珍珠奶茶.
column6: Tā dài zhe yī tiáo zhēnzhū xiàngliàn.
column7: She wears a pearl necklace.
column9: A pearl: 一顆珍珠 "a pearl", 珍珠項鏈 "pearl necklace", 珍珠奶茶 "bubble tea". Both characters have 王 on the left, where 王 is the form of 玉 jade in compounds, a sign that they are gems. Taiwan's bubble tea is called 珍珠奶茶.

column3: Before a noun for what convinces or works: 有力的证据, 有力的支持, 有力的措施. 有 plus a noun makes an adjective, as in 有用 and 有趣. The opposite is 无力.
column4: 警察找到了有力的证据。
column5: 警察找到了有力的證據。
column6: Jǐngchá zhǎodào le yǒulì de zhèngjù.
column7: The police found strong evidence.
column9: Before a noun for what convinces or works: 有力的證據, 有力的支持, 有力的措施. 有 plus a noun makes an adjective, as in 有用 and 有趣. The opposite is 無力.

column3: Priority in who or what comes first. After a noun it works like a sign: 老人优先. Before a verb: 优先考虑 and 优先录取. 优先权 is a right of priority.
column4: 在这里，老人和孩子优先。
column5: 在這裡，老人和孩子優先。
column6: Zài zhèlǐ, lǎorén hé háizi yōuxiān.
column7: Here, the elderly and children have priority.
column9: Priority in who or what comes first. After a noun it works like a sign: 老人優先. Before a verb: 優先考慮 and 優先錄取. 優先權 is a right of priority.

column3: A positive word for what seems almost magical: 神奇的力量, 神奇的效果, or the exclamation 真神奇. 神秘 is different: it is mysterious or hidden, not marvelous.
column4: 这个小岛上有一种神奇的花。
column5: 這個小島上有一種神奇的花。
column6: Zhège xiǎodǎo shàng yǒu yī zhǒng shénqí de huā.
column7: On this small island there is a magical kind of flower.
column9: A positive word for what seems almost magical: 神奇的力量, 神奇的效果, or the exclamation 真神奇. 神秘 is different: it is mysterious or hidden, not marvelous.

column3: A title for someone held up as an example, before a noun: 劳动模范, 模范教师, 模范员工. 范 is also the model in 示范 and 规范.
column4: 他被评为这个月的模范员工。
column5: 他被評為這個月的模範員工。
column6: Tā bèi píngwéi zhège yuè de mófàn yuángōng.
column7: He was chosen as this month's model employee.
column9: A title for someone held up as an example, before a noun: 勞動模範, 模範教師, 模範員工. 範 is also the model in 示範 and 規範.

column3: The wish is 祝你好运; for having it, 交好运 or 带来好运. In everyday talk 运气好 is more usual. 运 means luck as well as move, as in 运气 and 幸运.
column6: Míngtiān kǎoshì, zhù nǐ hǎoyùn!
column7: You have an exam tomorrow, good luck!
column9: The wish is 祝你好運; for having it, 交好運 or 帶來好運. In everyday talk 運氣好 is more usual. 運 means luck as well as move, as in 運氣 and 幸運.

column3: For deeds and duties that win public respect: 光荣的任务, 光荣传统, 感到光荣. It sounds official and is common in slogans; 自豪 is the personal feeling of pride.
column4: 当医生是一件光荣的事。
column5: 當醫生是一件光榮的事。
column6: Dāng yīshēng shì yī jiàn guāngróng de shì.
column7: Being a doctor is an honorable thing.
column9: For deeds and duties that win public respect: 光榮的任務, 光榮傳統, 感到光榮. It sounds official and is common in slogans; 自豪 is the personal feeling of pride.

column3: The special price or terms offered to customers: 优惠价, 优惠活动, 享受优惠. You see it on shop signs, tickets and ads, and in 优惠政策 for a preferential policy.
column4: 这家商店今天有优惠活动。
column5: 這家商店今天有優惠活動。
column6: Zhè jiā shāngdiàn jīntiān yǒu yōuhuì huódòng.
column7: This shop has a special offer today.
column9: The special price or terms offered to customers: 優惠價, 優惠活動, 享受優惠. You see it on shop signs, tickets and ads, and in 優惠政策 for a preferential policy.

column3: Praises a product or meal as worth the money: 价格实惠, 又好又实惠. As a noun it is a real gain rather than words: 得到实惠. 优惠 is the discount itself, 实惠 the verdict on the deal.
column4: 这家餐厅的菜又好吃又实惠。
column5: 這家餐廳的菜又好吃又實惠。
column6: Zhè jiā cāntīng de cài yòu hǎochī yòu shíhuì.
column7: The food at this restaurant is both tasty and good value.
column9: Praises a product or meal as worth the money: 價格實惠, 又好又實惠. As a noun it is a real gain rather than words: 得到實惠. 優惠 is the discount itself, 實惠 the verdict on the deal.

column3: Matter or material things, set against mind: 物质生活, 物质条件, with 精神 as the opposite. In science and health it is a substance: 有害物质.
column4: 他们的物质生活越来越丰富。
column5: 他們的物質生活越來越豐富。
column6: Tāmen de wùzhì shēnghuó yuè lái yuè fēngfù.
column7: Their material life is getting richer and richer.
column9: Matter or material things, set against mind: 物質生活, 物質條件, with 精神 as the opposite. In science and health it is a substance: 有害物質.

column3: Energy in physics and in the body: 补充能量, 消耗能量. 正能量 is an uplifting attitude. 能源 is energy as a resource, like oil or solar, while 能量 is how much energy something has.
column4: 食物给我们的身体提供能量。
column5: 食物給我們的身體提供能量。
column6: Shíwù gěi wǒmen de shēntǐ tígōng néngliàng.
column7: Food provides energy for our bodies.
column9: Energy in physics and in the body: 補充能量, 消耗能量. 正能量 is an uplifting attitude. 能源 is energy as a resource, like oil or solar, while 能量 is how much energy something has.

column3: In daily life this is calories: 热量高, 低热量, 控制热量. In physics it is heat: 释放热量. 量 is the amount in 能量, 数量 and 重量 too.
column6: Zhè zhǒng shíwù de rèliàng hěn gāo.
column7: This food is high in calories.
column9: In daily life this is calories: 熱量高, 低熱量, 控制熱量. In physics it is heat: 釋放熱量. 量 is the amount in 能量, 數量 and 重量 too.

column6: Wǒmen jiā yòng tiānránqì zuòfàn.
column7: Our home cooks with natural gas.

column3: A gas as a state of matter: 有毒气体, 排放气体, 气体和液体. With 液体 and 固体 it makes the three states. Gas for the stove is not 气体 but 煤气 or 天然气.
column6: Zhè zhǒng qìtǐ duì réntǐ yǒuhài.
column7: This gas is harmful to the human body.
column9: A gas as a state of matter: 有毒氣體, 排放氣體, 氣體和液體. With 液體 and 固體 it makes the three states. Gas for the stove is not 氣體 but 煤氣 or 天然氣.

column3: Rubbing and friction, and figuratively clashes between people or groups: 摩擦力, 发生摩擦, 贸易摩擦. 擦 alone is the everyday verb to wipe: 擦桌子, 擦汗.
column4: 两只手互相摩擦会发热。
column5: 兩隻手互相摩擦會發熱。
column6: Liǎng zhī shǒu hùxiāng mócā huì fārè.
column7: Rubbing two hands together makes heat.
column9: Rubbing and friction, and figuratively clashes between people or groups: 摩擦力, 發生摩擦, 貿易摩擦. 擦 alone is the everyday verb to wipe: 擦桌子, 擦汗.

column3: The technical word for regular back-and-forth shaking: 声音由振动产生. For a phone, 振动 and 震动 are both seen (震动模式). 震动 is also a shock or jolt, even a figurative one.
column6: Wǒ de shǒujī yīzhí zài zhèndòng.
column7: My phone keeps vibrating.
column9: The technical word for regular back-and-forth shaking: 聲音由振動產生. For a phone, 振動 and 震動 are both seen (震動模式). 震動 is also a shock or jolt, even a figurative one.

column3: Sends something out through the air or space: 发射火箭, 发射卫星, 发射信号. 发射台 is a launch pad. 发 is send out as in 发送, and 射 is shoot as in 射箭.
column4: 火箭将在明天早上发射。
column5: 火箭將在明天早上發射。
column6: Huǒjiàn jiāng zài míngtiān zǎoshang fāshè.
column7: The rocket will be launched tomorrow morning.
column9: Sends something out through the air or space: 發射火箭, 發射衛星, 發射信號. 發射臺 is a launch pad. 發 is send out as in 發送, and 射 is shoot as in 射箭.

column3: Machines, systems, trains and planets running their course: 系统运行正常, 列车运行, 运行速度. 运转 stresses parts turning and 运作 an organization operating.
column4: 这台机器已经连续运行了十个小时。
column5: 這台機器已經連續運行了十個小時。
column6: Zhè tái jīqì yǐjīng liánxù yùnxíng le shí ge xiǎoshí.
column7: This machine has been running for ten hours without stopping.
column9: Machines, systems, trains and planets running their course: 系統運行正常, 列車運行, 運行速度. 運轉 stresses parts turning and 運作 an organization operating.

column3: The space a thing takes up: 体积大, 体积小, 计算体积. A container's capacity is 容量, and loudness is 音量. 积 is also in 面积 for area.
column4: 这个箱子体积太大，放不进车里。
column5: 這個箱子體積太大，放不進車裡。
column6: Zhège xiāngzi tǐjī tài dà, fàng bù jìn chē lǐ.
column7: This box is too big to fit in the car.
column9: The space a thing takes up: 體積大, 體積小, 計算體積. A container's capacity is 容量, and loudness is 音量. 積 is also in 面積 for area.

column3: The water inside a fruit, a plant, the soil or your skin: 补充水分, 水分充足. Figuratively, padding: 数据有水分 means the numbers are inflated. Here 分 is read fen4, the “part” reading.
column4: 皮肤需要经常补充水分。
column5: 皮膚需要經常補充水分。
column6: Pífū xūyào jīngcháng bǔchōng shuǐfèn.
column7: Skin needs to have water added often.
column9: The water inside a fruit, a plant, the soil or your skin: 補充水分, 水分充足. Figuratively, padding: 數據有水分 means the numbers are inflated. Here 分 is read fen4, the “part” reading.

column3: What a machine or product can do, as in specs and reviews: 性能稳定, 性能强, 性能测试. It is said of devices, cars and software; for a person, use 能力.
column6: Zhè kuǎn shǒujī de xìngnéng hěn hǎo.
column7: This phone performs very well.
column9: What a machine or product can do, as in specs and reviews: 性能穩定, 性能強, 性能測試. It is said of devices, cars and software; for a person, use 能力.

column3: Says that something is the proper, official kind rather than informal or shady: 正规医院, 正规渠道, 正规公司. It goes straight before a noun, or after 很 or 不: 很正规, 不正规.
column6: Qǐng dào zhèngguī de yīyuàn kànbìng.
column7: Please go to a proper hospital for treatment.
column9: Says that something is the proper, official kind rather than informal or shady: 正規醫院, 正規渠道, 正規公司. It goes straight before a noun, or after 很 or 不: 很正規, 不正規.

column3: Works or is accepted in many places or by many people: a card or ticket, a language, a standard (全国通用, 通用语言). Parts and tools that fit several models are also 通用. The opposite is 专用, for one purpose only.
column6: Zhè zhǒng kǎ zài quánguó tōngyòng.
column7: This kind of card is valid throughout the country.
column9: Works or is accepted in many places or by many people: a card or ticket, a language, a standard (全國通用, 通用語言). Parts and tools that fit several models are also 通用. The opposite is 專用, for one purpose only.

column3: The “hot” of topics, majors, products and places that many people want: 热门话题, 热门专业, 热门景点. The opposite is 冷门, an unpopular field, which is also used for an unlikely winner.
column4: 这个专业现在非常热门。
column5: 這個專業現在非常熱門。
column6: Zhège zhuānyè xiànzài fēicháng rèmén.
column7: This major is very popular right now.
column9: The “hot” of topics, majors, products and places that many people want: 熱門話題, 熱門專業, 熱門景點. The opposite is 冷門, an unpopular field, which is also used for an unlikely winner.

column3: Private, as against public or official: 私人电话, 私人教练, 私人空间. It also covers a purely personal matter, as in 私人恩怨, a personal grudge. The opposite is 公共.
column4: 这是我的私人电话，请不要告诉别人。
column5: 這是我的私人電話，請不要告訴別人。
column6: Zhè shì wǒ de sīrén diànhuà, qǐng bù yào gàosu biéren.
column7: This is my private number; please do not tell anyone.
column9: Private, as against public or official: 私人電話, 私人教練, 私人空間. It also covers a purely personal matter, as in 私人恩怨, a personal grudge. The opposite is 公共.

column3: Enough, and then some, said of things you want plenty of: 阳光充足, 睡眠充足, 资金充足, 理由充足. It describes supplies, light, sleep and reasons; for “be enough” as a plain verb, use 够.
column4: 这里阳光充足，适合种花。
column5: 這裡陽光充足，適合種花。
column6: Zhèlǐ yángguāng chōngzú, shìhé zhòng huā.
column7: There is plenty of sunshine here, which suits growing flowers.
column9: Enough, and then some, said of things you want plenty of: 陽光充足, 睡眠充足, 資金充足, 理由充足. It describes supplies, light, sleep and reasons; for “be enough” as a plain verb, use 夠.

column3: Convenient, a bit more formal than 方便. It is used for access and services: 交通便利, 生活便利, 提供便利. A convenience store is 便利店 on the mainland and 便利商店 or 超商 in Taiwan.
column6: Zhèlǐ de jiāotōng fēicháng biànlì.
column7: Getting around here is very convenient.
column9: Convenient, a bit more formal than 方便. It is used for access and services: 交通便利, 生活便利, 提供便利. A convenience store is 便利店 on the mainland and 便利商店 or 超商 in Taiwan.

column3: Points to one particular case among others, in careful or official language: 特定的时间, 特定人群, 在特定条件下. It means “set apart”, not “detailed”: for detailed, say 具体.
column4: 这种药只适用于特定的人群。
column5: 這種藥只適用於特定的人群。
column6: Zhè zhǒng yào zhǐ shìyòng yú tèdìng de rénqún.
column7: This medicine is only suitable for a particular group of people.
column9: Points to one particular case among others, in careful or official language: 特定的時間, 特定人群, 在特定條件下. It means “set apart”, not “detailed”: for detailed, say 具體.

column3: A property built into a material, a species or a device: 物理特性, 生物特性. The everyday word for a feature, of places and people too, is 特点. 特性 is more technical.
column4: 每种金属都有自己的特性。
column5: 每種金屬都有自己的特性。
column6: Měi zhǒng jīnshǔ dōu yǒu zìjǐ de tèxìng.
column7: Every metal has its own characteristics.
column9: A property built into a material, a species or a device: 物理特性, 生物特性. The everyday word for a feature, of places and people too, is 特點. 特性 is more technical.

column3: Found only in a certain place, group or thing, and nearly always followed by 的 and a noun: 特有的风格, 中国特有的动物, 这座城市特有的味道. What it describes is not shared with others.
column4: 大熊猫是中国特有的动物。
column5: 大熊貓是中國特有的動物。
column6: Dàxióngmāo shì Zhōngguó tèyǒu de dòngwù.
column7: The giant panda is an animal unique to China.
column9: Found only in a certain place, group or thing, and nearly always followed by 的 and a noun: 特有的風格, 中國特有的動物, 這座城市特有的味道. What it describes is not shared with others.

column3: As an adjective, said of a system, a body or a mind that works as it should: 制度健全, 身心健全, 不健全. As a verb, to build up and perfect: 健全法制. The opposite is 不健全.
column4: 这家公司的管理制度很健全。
column5: 這家公司的管理制度很健全。
column6: Zhè jiā gōngsī de guǎnlǐ zhìdù hěn jiànquán.
column7: This company’s management system is very sound.
column9: As an adjective, said of a system, a body or a mind that works as it should: 制度健全, 身心健全, 不健全. As a verb, to build up and perfect: 健全法制. The opposite is 不健全.

column3: Everything you would expect is there. It describes shops, equipment and paperwork, often in ads: 品种齐全, 设备齐全, 手续齐全. It is said of a set, not of one item. The same 齐 means “all present” in 到齐, said when everyone has arrived.
column4: 这家超市的商品种类很齐全。
column5: 這家超市的商品種類很齊全。
column6: Zhè jiā chāoshì de shāngpǐn zhǒnglèi hěn qíquán.
column7: This supermarket has a full range of goods.
column9: Everything you would expect is there. It describes shops, equipment and paperwork, often in ads: 品種齊全, 設備齊全, 手續齊全. It is said of a set, not of one item. The same 齊 means “all present” in 到齊, said when everyone has arrived.

column3: Accepted by everyone. It is nearly always used as 被公认为…, “is generally recognized as”, or as 公认的 before a noun: 公认的事实, 公认的好办法.
column4: 他被公认为这个领域最好的专家。
column5: 他被公認為這個領域最好的專家。
column6: Tā bèi gōngrèn wéi zhège lǐngyù zuì hǎo de zhuānjiā.
column7: He is generally recognized as the best expert in this field.
column9: Accepted by everyone. It is nearly always used as 被公認為…, “is generally recognized as”, or as 公認的 before a noun: 公認的事實, 公認的好辦法.

column3: Laws and regulations taken together, especially rules issued by a government body: 法律法规, 遵守法规, 行业法规. One statute passed by the legislature is a 法律; 法规 is the wider body of rules. 规 began as a picture of a measuring compass.
column4: 公司必须遵守相关的法规。
column5: 公司必須遵守相關的法規。
column6: Gōngsī bìxū zūnshǒu xiāngguān de fǎguī.
column7: The company must comply with the relevant regulations.
column9: Laws and regulations taken together, especially rules issued by a government body: 法律法規, 遵守法規, 行業法規. One statute passed by the legislature is a 法律; 法規 is the wider body of rules. 規 began as a picture of a measuring compass.

column3: The legal system and how it is carried out: 法制社会, 加强法制, 法制教育. Do not mix it up with 法治, “rule of law” as a principle, which sounds exactly the same and is often found in 依法治国.
column6: Wǒmen yào jiāqiáng fǎzhì jiàoyù.
column7: We should strengthen education on the legal system.
column9: The legal system and how it is carried out: 法制社會, 加強法制, 法制教育. Do not mix it up with 法治, “rule of law” as a principle, which sounds exactly the same and is often found in 依法治國.

column3: To break the law, and with 的 “illegal”: 违法行为, 这样做是违法的. It is a verb plus its object, so it can be split: 违了法. The 违 here is “go against”, as in 违反, 违规 and 违约.
column6: Zài zhèlǐ tíngchē shì wéifǎ de.
column7: It is illegal to park here.
column9: To break the law, and with 的 “illegal”: 違法行為, 這樣做是違法的. It is a verb plus its object, so it can be split: 違了法. The 違 here is “go against”, as in 違反, 違規 and 違約.

column3: Takes the rule as its object: 违反规定, 违反合同, 违反交通规则. It covers laws, contracts and school or company rules. 违法 cannot take an object, so you cannot say 违法规定.
column6: Tā wéifǎn le xuéxiào de guīdìng.
column7: He broke the school’s rules.
column9: Takes the rule as its object: 違反規定, 違反合同, 違反交通規則. It covers laws, contracts and school or company rules. 違法 cannot take an object, so you cannot say 違法規定.

column3: Breaking the rules of a sport, a company or the road, usually less serious than a crime: 违规操作, 违规停车. Like 违法 it takes no object. News about sports and traffic is full of it. 规 began as a picture of a measuring compass.
column4: 这名选手因为违规被取消了成绩。
column5: 這名選手因為違規被取消了成績。
column6: Zhè míng xuǎnshǒu yīnwèi wéiguī bèi qǔxiāo le chéngjì.
column7: This athlete had the result canceled for breaking the rules.
column9: Breaking the rules of a sport, a company or the road, usually less serious than a crime: 違規操作, 違規停車. Like 違法 it takes no object. News about sports and traffic is full of it. 規 began as a picture of a measuring compass.

column3: A punishment handed down by an authority, usually a fine, a ban or a warning, and also the verb: 受到处罚, 行政处罚, 从轻处罚. It sounds official. In this word 处 is read chu3, “to punish”, not the chu4 “place”.
column6: Luàn rēng lājī huì shòudào chǔfá.
column7: Littering will get you penalized.
column9: A punishment handed down by an authority, usually a fine, a ban or a warning, and also the verb: 受到處罰, 行政處罰, 從輕處罰. It sounds official. In this word 處 is read chu3, “to punish”, not the chu4 “place”.

column3: A formal disciplinary measure that a school, company or government body enters in your record: 受处分, 给予处分, 警告处分. 处罚 is the penalty itself, such as a fine. Both syllables have a second reading: 处 is chu3 here (“to punish”) and 分 is fen4 (“part”).
column4: 他因为作弊受到了处分。
column5: 他因為作弊受到了處分。
column6: Tā yīnwèi zuòbì shòudào le chǔfèn.
column7: He was disciplined for cheating.
column9: A formal disciplinary measure that a school, company or government body enters in your record: 受處分, 給予處分, 警告處分. 處罰 is the penalty itself, such as a fine. Both syllables have a second reading: 處 is chu3 here (“to punish”) and 分 is fen4 (“part”).

column3: An adverb that goes before a verb: 依法办事, 依法纳税, 依法处理. It belongs to laws, notices and news; in speech people say 按法律 or 按规定. The same pattern exists with 依规 and 依约.
column6: Gōngmín dōu yào yīfǎ nàshuì.
column7: All citizens must pay taxes according to the law.
column9: An adverb that goes before a verb: 依法辦事, 依法納稅, 依法處理. It belongs to laws, notices and news; in speech people say 按法律 or 按規定. The same pattern exists with 依規 and 依約.

column3: How orderly and safe a place is from crime and disorder: 治安好, 社会治安, 维护治安. It is not safety from accidents or disasters; that is 安全.
column6: Zhège chéngshì de zhì'ān hěn hǎo.
column7: Public safety is good in this city.
column9: How orderly and safe a place is from crime and disorder: 治安好, 社會治安, 維護治安. It is not safety from accidents or disasters; that is 安全.

column3: To bring a large problem or region under control through steady work: 治理污染, 治理环境, 治理国家. The object is something big, never one person. It also means governance: 社会治理. 治 has water 氵 in it and can mean taming a river.
column4: 政府正在治理河水污染。
column5: 政府正在治理河水污染。
column6: Zhèngfǔ zhèngzài zhìlǐ héshuǐ wūrǎn.
column7: The government is working to clean up the pollution of the river.
column9: To bring a large problem or region under control through steady work: 治理污染, 治理環境, 治理國家. The object is something big, never one person. It also means governance: 社會治理. 治 has water 氵 in it and can mean taming a river.

column3: Used for a rule, a law or a promise that already exists: 遵守规则, 遵守交通规则, 遵守诺言. You 遵守 a rule but 服从 a person or an order.
column4: 大家都要遵守交通规则。
column5: 大家都要遵守交通規則。
column6: Dàjiā dōu yào zūnshǒu jiāotōng guīzé.
column7: Everyone must obey the traffic rules.
column9: Used for a rule, a law or a promise that already exists: 遵守規則, 遵守交通規則, 遵守諾言. You 遵守 a rule but 服從 a person or an order.

column3: You 服从 a person, an order or a decision: 服从命令, 服从安排, and a majority: 少数服从多数. It suggests setting your own view aside. For a rule or law, the word is 遵守.
column6: Shìbīng bìxū fúcóng mìnglìng.
column7: Soldiers must obey orders.
column9: You 服從 a person, an order or a decision: 服從命令, 服從安排, and a majority: 少數服從多數. It suggests setting your own view aside. For a rule or law, the word is 遵守.

column3: A limit on behavior, put on you by rules or by yourself: 约束自己, 受到约束, 缺乏约束. It is both a verb and a noun. 束 began as a bag tied at both ends.
column6: Háizi xūyào jiāzhǎng de yuēshù.
column7: Children need limits set by their parents.
column9: A limit on behavior, put on you by rules or by yourself: 約束自己, 受到約束, 缺乏約束. It is both a verb and a noun. 束 began as a bag tied at both ends.

column3: Used for factors and conditions that hold each other or something else back: 相互制约, 受到制约, 制约发展. It usually describes a system or situation, not one person controlling another.
column4: 经济条件制约着学校的发展。
column5: 經濟條件制約著學校的發展。
column6: Jīngjì tiáojiàn zhìyuē zhe xuéxiào de fāzhǎn.
column7: Economic conditions limit the school’s development.
column9: Used for factors and conditions that hold each other or something else back: 相互制約, 受到制約, 制約發展. It usually describes a system or situation, not one person controlling another.

column3: A flat ban from someone in charge, spoken to children, students or staff: 不许说话, 不许迟到, 不许动 (“Freeze!”). It sounds like a command. A softer ban is 不可以; written signs use 禁止.
column4: 上课的时候不许玩手机。
column5: 上課的時候不許玩手機。
column6: Shàngkè de shíhou bùxǔ wán shǒujī.
column7: You are not allowed to play with your phone in class.
column9: A flat ban from someone in charge, spoken to children, students or staff: 不許說話, 不許遲到, 不許動 (“Freeze!”). It sounds like a command. A softer ban is 不可以; written signs use 禁止.

column3: Fair and impartial in judging: 公正的判决, 公正地对待, 公平公正. It suits judges, referees and decisions that favor no side. 公平 is fairness in how things are shared out.
column6: Fǎguān de pànjué gōngzhèng hélǐ.
column7: The judge’s ruling is fair and reasonable.
column9: Fair and impartial in judging: 公正的判決, 公正地對待, 公平公正. It suits judges, referees and decisions that favor no side. 公平 is fairness in how things are shared out.

column3: Justice as a moral idea, or “just” before 的 and a noun: 伸张正义, 正义感, 正义的事业. Courts and the legal system are 司法; 正义 is the moral side of right and wrong.
column4: 他想为受害者伸张正义。
column5: 他想為受害者伸張正義。
column6: Tā xiǎng wèi shòuhàizhě shēnzhāng zhèngyì.
column7: He wants to see justice done for the victims.
column9: Justice as a moral idea, or “just” before 的 and a noun: 伸張正義, 正義感, 正義的事業. Courts and the legal system are 司法; 正義 is the moral side of right and wrong.

column3: It has two everyday uses: the exact middle (广场中央) and, in the news, the central government (中央政府). 中间 is the plain “in the middle” of speech; 中央 is more formal and points to the center. 中 is read as a flagpole with a drum, which was placed in the center of a field.
column6: Guǎngchǎng zhōngyāng yǒu yī zuò pēnquán.
column7: There is a fountain in the middle of the square.
column9: It has two everyday uses: the exact middle (廣場中央) and, in the news, the central government (中央政府). 中間 is the plain “in the middle” of speech; 中央 is more formal and points to the center. 中 is read as a flagpole with a drum, which was placed in the center of a field.

column3: The country whose citizen you legally are, as asked on forms and at borders: 你是哪国国籍? 双重国籍, 加入国籍. It is not ethnicity; that is 民族. 籍 is built from bamboo and was, in the source’s words, the (bamboo) census books.
column6: Tā yǒu liǎng ge guójiā de guójí.
column7: He holds citizenship in two countries.
column9: The country whose citizen you legally are, as asked on forms and at borders: 你是哪國國籍? 雙重國籍, 加入國籍. It is not ethnicity; that is 民族. 籍 is built from bamboo and was, in the source’s words, the (bamboo) census books.

column3: The person or body above you in an organization: 向上级汇报, 上级领导, 听从上级. The opposite is 下级. 上司 is your boss as a person; 上级 can also be a whole office. 级 is a level in other words too: 年级, 高级, 初级.
column4: 这件事需要先向上级报告。
column5: 這件事需要先向上級報告。
column6: Zhè jiàn shì xūyào xiān xiàng shàngjí bàogào.
column7: This matter has to be reported to a superior first.
column9: The person or body above you in an organization: 向上級匯報, 上級領導, 聽從上級. The opposite is 下級. 上司 is your boss as a person; 上級 can also be a whole office. 級 is a level in other words too: 年級, 高級, 初級.

column3: Power held by a group, and the group itself: 势力范围, 扩大势力, 恶势力. It often has a negative tone, since it names those who hold power. Neutral “influence” is 影响力. 力 may show an arm or a plow.
column4: 这个组织的势力越来越大。
column5: 這個組織的勢力越來越大。
column6: Zhège zǔzhī de shìli yuè lái yuè dà.
column7: This organization is getting more and more influential.
column9: Power held by a group, and the group itself: 勢力範圍, 擴大勢力, 惡勢力. It often has a negative tone, since it names those who hold power. Neutral “influence” is 影響力. 力 may show an arm or a plow.

column3: The position you take on an issue, where you stand: 政治立场, 坚持立场. The pattern 站在……的立场上 means taking someone’s side or putting yourself in their place. 立 began as a picture of a person standing on the ground.
column4: 请你站在我的立场想一想。
column5: 請你站在我的立場想一想。
column6: Qǐng nǐ zhàn zài wǒ de lìchǎng xiǎng yī xiǎng.
column7: Please think about it from my point of view.
column9: The position you take on an issue, where you stand: 政治立場, 堅持立場. The pattern 站在……的立場上 means taking someone’s side or putting yourself in their place. 立 began as a picture of a person standing on the ground.

column3: A group seen as one whole because its members share something: 年轻群体, 消费群体, 弱势群体, 群体活动. A random crowd of people is 人群. 群 has 羊 (sheep) in it: a herd of sheep, hence a group.
column4: 年轻人是这家店的主要消费群体。
column5: 年輕人是這家店的主要消費群體。
column6: Niánqīngrén shì zhè jiā diàn de zhǔyào xiāofèi qúntǐ.
column7: Young people are this shop’s main group of customers.
column9: A group seen as one whole because its members share something: 年輕群體, 消費群體, 弱勢群體, 群體活動. A random crowd of people is 人群. 群 has 羊 (sheep) in it: a herd of sheep, hence a group.

column3: It does not stand alone. It ends words for an organization: 出版社, 报社, 旅行社, 通讯社. It also begins others: 社会, 社区.
column4: 我的姐姐在一家出版社工作。
column5: 我的姐姐在一家出版社工作。
column6: Wǒ de jiějie zài yī jiā chūbǎn shè gōngzuò.
column7: My older sister works at a publishing house.
column9: It does not stand alone. It ends words for an organization: 出版社, 報社, 旅行社, 通訊社. It also begins others: 社會, 社區.

column3: To roll out a policy, system or practice over a wide area, from above: 推行新政策, 推行垃圾分类, 推行改革. The object is something institutional, not a person or a personal plan.
column4: 政府在全国推行新的教育政策。
column5: 政府在全國推行新的教育政策。
column6: Zhèngfǔ zài quánguó tuīxíng xīn de jiàoyù zhèngcè.
column7: The government is carrying out a new education policy across the country.
column9: To roll out a policy, system or practice over a wide area, from above: 推行新政策, 推行垃圾分類, 推行改革. The object is something institutional, not a person or a personal plan.

column3: A deep change to a system or institution, bigger than 改变: 经济改革, 教育改革. 改革开放, “reform and opening up”, is the name of China’s policy from the late 1970s.
column4: 这个国家正在进行教育改革。
column5: 這個國家正在進行教育改革。
column6: Zhège guójiā zhèngzài jìnxíng jiàoyù gǎigé.
column7: This country is carrying out education reform.
column9: A deep change to a system or institution, bigger than 改變: 經濟改革, 教育改革. 改革開放, “reform and opening up”, is the name of China’s policy from the late 1970s.

column3: To lead as the main force that sets the direction, or “leading” before a noun: 主导地位, 主导作用, 由……主导. 领导 leads people; 主导 is for whoever or whatever has the main say. The 导 in it is “lead” in other words too: 引导, 指导, 领导.
column4: 这个项目由年轻人主导。
column5: 這個項目由年輕人主導。
column6: Zhège xiàngmù yóu niánqīngrén zhǔdǎo.
column7: This project is led by young people.
column9: To lead as the main force that sets the direction, or “leading” before a noun: 主導地位, 主導作用, 由……主導. 領導 leads people; 主導 is for whoever or whatever has the main say. The 導 in it is “lead” in other words too: 引導, 指導, 領導.

column3: Two senses: the main part of a thing (建筑主体), and the party that acts or holds a right (责任主体, 市场主体). The second is “subject”, with 客体 as its opposite.
column4: 这座桥的主体已经完工。
column5: 這座橋的主體已經完工。
column6: Zhè zuò qiáo de zhǔtǐ yǐjīng wángōng.
column7: The main structure of the bridge has been completed.
column9: Two senses: the main part of a thing (建築主體), and the party that acts or holds a right (責任主體, 市場主體). The second is “subject”, with 客體 as its opposite.

column3: The human world, as against heaven, mostly in set phrases and writing: 人间天堂, 人间烟火, 来到人间. In everyday speech, 人间蒸发 means to vanish without a trace.
column6: Hángzhōu bèi chēngwéi rénjiān tiāntáng.
column7: Hangzhou is called heaven on earth.
column9: The human world, as against heaven, mostly in set phrases and writing: 人間天堂, 人間煙火, 來到人間. In everyday speech, 人間蒸發 means to vanish without a trace.

column3: The moral standards a society accepts: 道德标准, 职业道德, 不道德. 品德 is one person’s moral character, and 伦理 is ethics as a field of thought. 道 possibly shows a head walking on a road.
column6: Zhèyàng zuò bù fúhé dàodé.
column7: Doing it this way goes against morality.
column9: The moral standards a society accepts: 道德標準, 職業道德, 不道德. 品德 is one person’s moral character, and 倫理 is ethics as a field of thought. 道 possibly shows a head walking on a road.

column3: A symbol of an idea, and the verb: 和平的象征, 象征着, 象征意义. A written mark such as 标点符号 or 数学符号 is a 符号; 象征 is for a thing that stands for an idea, like the dove for peace. One old explanation of how 象 came to mean “likeness”: people rarely saw living elephants and imagined one from the skeleton of a dead one.
column6: Gēzi shì hépíng de xiàngzhēng.
column7: The dove is a symbol of peace.
column9: A symbol of an idea, and the verb: 和平的象徵, 象徵著, 象徵意義. A written mark such as 標點符號 or 數學符號 is a 符號; 象徵 is for a thing that stands for an idea, like the dove for peace. One old explanation of how 象 came to mean “likeness”: people rarely saw living elephants and imagined one from the skeleton of a dead one.

column3: To win an election or be chosen, with the post following: 当选总统, 当选为班长, 高票当选. The winner is the subject, while the voters are the subject of 选. Here 当 is read dang1, “to be; to act as”, not dang4, “to regard as”.
column6: Tā gāopiào dāngxuǎn wéi bānzhǎng.
column7: He was elected class president by a large majority.
column9: To win an election or be chosen, with the post following: 當選總統, 當選為班長, 高票當選. The winner is the subject, while the voters are the subject of 選. Here 當 is read dang1, “to be; to act as”, not dang4, “to regard as”.

column3: A title given for merit or fame: 荣誉称号, 获得称号, 冠军称号. It is not the job title on a business card; that is 职位. 称 alone means “to call”, as in 称为 and 称呼.
column4: 她获得了“优秀教师”的称号。
column5: 她獲得了「優秀教師」的稱號。
column6: Tā huòdé le “yōuxiù jiàoshī” de chēnghào.
column7: She was given the title of “excellent teacher”.
column9: A title given for merit or fame: 榮譽稱號, 獲得稱號, 冠軍稱號. It is not the job title on a business card; that is 職位. 稱 alone means “to call”, as in 稱為 and 稱呼.

column3: To defend against attack, with a stirring tone: 保卫国家, 保卫家园, 保卫和平. For keeping people, data or the environment from harm, the word is 保护. In the oracle script 保 showed a person carrying a child on his back.
column4: 士兵们誓死保卫自己的家园。
column5: 士兵們誓死保衛自己的家園。
column6: Shìbīngmen shìsǐ bǎowèi zìjǐ de jiāyuán.
column7: The soldiers vowed to defend their homeland to the death.
column9: To defend against attack, with a stirring tone: 保衛國家, 保衛家園, 保衛和平. For keeping people, data or the environment from harm, the word is 保護. In the oracle script 保 showed a person carrying a child on his back.

column3: To surround from all sides, often in the passive: 被包围, 被群山包围. It suits troops, a crowd or scenery. 围绕 is different: to go round something or center on it. 包 is a picture of a fetus in the womb, or a swaddled baby.
column6: Xiǎo cūnzi bèi qúnshān bāowéi zhe.
column7: The small village is surrounded by mountains.
column9: To surround from all sides, often in the passive: 被包圍, 被群山包圍. It suits troops, a crowd or scenery. 圍繞 is different: to go round something or center on it. 包 is a picture of a fetus in the womb, or a swaddled baby.

column3: Anyone in the armed forces, officers included: 退伍军人, 现役军人. 士兵 is a rank-and-file soldier. 军 is the military in 军队, 海军 and 空军.
column6: Tā shì yī míng guāngróng de jūnrén.
column7: He is a proud soldier.
column9: Anyone in the armed forces, officers included: 退伍軍人, 現役軍人. 士兵 is a rank-and-file soldier. 軍 is the military in 軍隊, 海軍 and 空軍.

column3: To occupy or seize by force a place: 占领城市 "occupy a city", 占领市场 "capture a market", 被占领. It is military, and is also used for taking a market share. 占 "occupy" + 领 "take over". Read zhan4 here.
column6: Dírén zhànlǐng le zhè zuò chéngshì.
column7: The enemy occupied this city.
column9: To occupy or seize by force a place: 佔領城市 "occupy a city", 佔領市場 "capture a market", 被佔領. It is military, and is also used for taking a market share. 佔 "occupy" + 領 "take over". Read zhan4 here.

column3: A bullet: 一颗子弹 "a bullet", 子弹上膛 "load a round", 防弹 "bulletproof". It has 弹 read dan4, "bullet" here, unlike dan2 "to flick" or "play". 子 "small thing" + 弹 "pellet".
column6: Yī kē zǐdàn dǎzhòng le qiáng.
column7: A bullet hit the wall.
column9: A bullet: 一顆子彈 "a bullet", 子彈上膛 "load a round", 防彈 "bulletproof". It has 彈 read dan4, "bullet" here, unlike dan2 "to flick" or "play". 子 "small thing" + 彈 "pellet".

column3: A gun or rifle, and a spear: 开枪 "fire a gun", 手枪 "pistol", 一把枪 "a gun", 枪声 "the sound of a shot". The measure word is 把, and for shots it is 枪. The 木 on the left is wood, since the spear had a wooden shaft.
column6: Jǐngchá shǒu lǐ názhe yī bǎ qiāng.
column7: The policeman holds a gun in his hand.
column9: A gun or rifle, and a spear: 開槍 "fire a gun", 手槍 "pistol", 一把槍 "a gun", 槍聲 "the sound of a shot". The measure word is 把, and for shots it is 槍. The 木 on the left is wood, since the spear had a wooden shaft.

column3: To kill: 杀人 "kill someone", 杀鸡 "kill a chicken", 杀死 "kill, with a result", 被杀. Used after another verb it means "extremely", but that is dialect. It is a plain, direct word.
column6: Tāmen zuótiān shā le yī zhī jī.
column7: They killed a chicken yesterday.
column9: To kill: 殺人 "kill someone", 殺雞 "kill a chicken", 殺死 "kill, with a result", 被殺. Used after another verb it means "extremely", but that is dialect. It is a plain, direct word.

column3: To commit suicide: 自杀事件 "a suicide case", 企图自杀 "attempt suicide", 选择自杀. It is a plain word used in news and in medicine. 自 "self" + 杀 "kill".
column4: 新闻报道了一起自杀事件。
column5: 新聞報導了一起自殺事件。
column6: Xīnwén bàodào le yī qǐ zìshā shìjiàn.
column7: The news reported a suicide case.
column9: To commit suicide: 自殺事件 "a suicide case", 企圖自殺 "attempt suicide", 選擇自殺. It is a plain word used in news and in medicine. 自 "self" + 殺 "kill".

column3: Conflict or clash, of people, interests or opinions: 发生冲突 "a clash occurs", 避免冲突 "avoid conflict", 利益冲突 "conflict of interest". It is also a verb: 时间冲突 "the times conflict". 冲 "rush" + 突 "burst".
column6: Liǎng guó zhījiān fāshēng le chōngtū.
column7: A conflict broke out between the two countries.
column9: Conflict or clash, of people, interests or opinions: 發生衝突 "a clash occurs", 避免衝突 "avoid conflict", 利益衝突 "conflict of interest". It is also a verb: 時間衝突 "the times conflict". 衝 "rush" + 突 "burst".

column3: To oppose each other, or opposed: 对立的双方 "the opposing sides", 互相对立 "stand against each other", 对立面 "opposite side". It is about two things or parties placed against each other. 对 "facing" + 立 "stand".
column6: Liǎng zhǒng guāndiǎn wánquán duìlì.
column7: The two views are completely opposed.
column9: To oppose each other, or opposed: 對立的雙方 "the opposing sides", 互相對立 "stand against each other", 對立面 "opposite side". It is about two things or parties placed against each other. 對 "facing" + 立 "stand".

column3: A contradiction, a conflict, and "contradictory": 内心矛盾 "inner conflict", 产生矛盾 "have a conflict", 自相矛盾 "contradict oneself". 矛 is a spear and 盾 a shield, and the story of the seller who said both could not be beaten gave the word. Also a verb: 他说得很矛盾.
column4: 他们之间产生了一些矛盾。
column5: 他們之間產生了一些矛盾。
column6: Tāmen zhījiān chǎnshēng le yīxiē máodùn.
column7: Some conflicts arose between them.
column9: A contradiction, a conflict, and "contradictory": 內心矛盾 "inner conflict", 產生矛盾 "have a conflict", 自相矛盾 "contradict oneself". 矛 is a spear and 盾 a shield, and the story of the seller who said both could not be beaten gave the word. Also a verb: 他說得很矛盾.

column3: To disturb or interfere with something, and interference: 干扰工作 "disturb work", 受到干扰 "be interrupted", 信号干扰 "signal interference". It is for outside forces that stop a process. 干 here is read gan1.
column6: Zàoyīn gānrǎo le wǒ de xuéxí.
column7: Noise disturbed my studying.
column9: To disturb or interfere with something, and interference: 干擾工作 "disturb work", 受到干擾 "be interrupted", 信號干擾 "signal interference". It is for outside forces that stop a process. 干 here is read gan1.

column3: To intervene or meddle in something: 政府干预 "government intervention", 干预内政 "interfere in internal affairs", 不要干预 "don't interfere". It can be neutral or negative depending on who intervenes. 干 is read gan1, "get involved".
column4: 家长不应该过多地干预孩子的选择。
column5: 家長不應該過多地干預孩子的選擇。
column6: Jiāzhǎng bù yīnggāi guòduō de gānyù háizi de xuǎnzé.
column7: Parents should not interfere too much in their children's choices.
column9: To intervene or meddle in something: 政府干預 "government intervention", 干預內政 "interfere in internal affairs", 不要干預 "don't interfere". It can be neutral or negative depending on who intervenes. 干 is read gan1, "get involved".

column3: To lead a group, such as a team or army: 率领代表团 "lead a delegation", 率领队伍 "lead the troops". The object is a group that follows. Read shuai4 here, "lead", not lü4 "rate". It is formal.
column4: 他率领代表团访问了法国。
column5: 他率領代表團訪問了法國。
column6: Tā shuàilǐng dàibiǎotuán fǎngwèn le Fǎguó.
column7: He led the delegation on a visit to France.
column9: To lead a group, such as a team or army: 率領代表團 "lead a delegation", 率領隊伍 "lead the troops". The object is a group that follows. Read shuai4 here, "lead", not lü4 "rate". It is formal.

column3: To liberate or set free: 解放思想 "free one's mind", 解放生产力, 解放军 "the People's Liberation Army". In the political sense, 解放 refers to the 1949 communist victory. It also means to free one's hands from drudgery: 解放双手. 解 "release" + 放 "let go".
column4: 洗衣机解放了人们的双手。
column5: 洗衣機解放了人們的雙手。
column6: Xǐyījī jiěfàng le rénmen de shuāngshǒu.
column7: The washing machine freed people's hands.
column9: To liberate or set free: 解放思想 "free one's mind", 解放生產力, 解放軍 "the People's Liberation Army". In the political sense, 解放 refers to the 1949 communist victory. It also means to free one's hands from drudgery: 解放雙手. 解 "release" + 放 "let go".

column3: Will or about to, in written style: 将来 "future", 将要 "be about to", 即将 "soon", and the structure 将…拿走, which is the written form of 把. 将 also means "general" in the other reading (jiang4), as in 将军. In this reading it is a bound form.
column4: 会议将于明天上午九点开始。
column5: 會議將於明天上午九點開始。
column6: Huìyì jiāng yú míngtiān shàngwǔ jiǔ diǎn kāishǐ.
column7: The meeting will begin at nine tomorrow morning.
column9: Will or about to, in written style: 將來 "future", 將要 "be about to", 即將 "soon", and the structure 將…拿走, which is the written form of 把. 將 also means "general" in the other reading (jiang4), as in 將軍. In this reading it is a bound form.

column3: About to, will soon: 将要毕业 "about to graduate", 将要发生 "going to happen", 就要 "about to" is the spoken form. It sits before a verb and gives a near future. It is written and a little formal.
column6: Zhè liè huǒchē jiāngyào dào zhàn le.
column7: This train is about to arrive at the station.
column9: About to, will soon: 將要畢業 "about to graduate", 將要發生 "going to happen", 就要 "about to" is the spoken form. It sits before a verb and gives a near future. It is written and a little formal.

column3: To respond or answer, and to comply with: 应邀 "at someone's invitation", 应聘 "apply for a post", 答应 "promise", 反应 "reaction", 应付 "deal with". It is read ying4 for these; for "should" it is ying1, as in 应该. It is a bound form in compounds.
column6: Tā yìngyāo cānjiā le kāimùshì.
column7: He took part in the opening ceremony at the invitation of the organizers.
column9: To respond or answer, and to comply with: 應邀 "at someone's invitation", 應聘 "apply for a post", 答應 "promise", 反應 "reaction", 應付 "deal with". It is read ying4 for these; for "should" it is ying1, as in 應該. It is a bound form in compounds.

column3: Can or may, in compounds, and as a spoken emphasis: 可以 "can", 可能 "maybe", 可爱 "lovable", 可是 "but". In speech 可 adds emphasis: 你可来了 "you've finally come", 这可不行 "this really won't do".
column6: Zhè jiàn shì kě bù jiǎndān.
column7: This is really not simple.
column9: Can or may, in compounds, and as a spoken emphasis: 可以 "can", 可能 "maybe", 可愛 "lovable", 可是 "but". In speech 可 adds emphasis: 你可來了 "you've finally come", 這可不行 "this really won't do".

column3: His, her, its, their, or that, in written Chinese: 其中 "among them", 其他 "other", 其实 "in fact", 其次 "next", 各得其所. It is a bound form, rarely used alone in speech. 其 stands for something said earlier, and it is the first character of many common words.
column4: 这里有五个学生，其中三个是女生。
column5: 這裡有五個學生，其中三個是女生。
column6: Zhèlǐ yǒu wǔ ge xuésheng, qízhōng sān ge shì nǚshēng.
column7: There are five students here, and three of them are girls.
column9: His, her, its, their, or that, in written Chinese: 其中 "among them", 其他 "other", 其實 "in fact", 其次 "next", 各得其所. It is a bound form, rarely used alone in speech. 其 stands for something said earlier, and it is the first character of many common words.

column3: To arrive, until, or "most": 至少 "at least", 至今 "until now", 直至 "right up to", 至于 "as for", 甚至 "even". It is a written word, mostly used in compounds. 从…至… means "from … to …", as in 从周一至周五.
column6: Tā zhìjīn hái méiyǒu huí jiā.
column7: He has not come home until now.
column9: To arrive, until, or "most": 至少 "at least", 至今 "until now", 直至 "right up to", 至於 "as for", 甚至 "even". It is a written word, mostly used in compounds. 從…至… means "from … to …", as in 從週一至週五.

column3: To make or cause, written style: 令人高兴 "makes one happy", 令人失望 "disappointing", 令人感动 "touching". The pattern is 令 + person + feeling. It also means an order, as in 命令 and 法令.
column4: 这个好消息令大家非常高兴。
column5: 這個好消息令大家非常高興。
column6: Zhège hǎo xiāoxi lìng dàjiā fēicháng gāoxìng.
column7: This good news made everybody very happy.
column9: To make or cause, written style: 令人高興 "makes one happy", 令人失望 "disappointing", 令人感動 "touching". The pattern is 令 + person + feeling. It also means an order, as in 命令 and 法令.

column3: The first of the ten Heavenly Stems, used as "A" or "first": 甲方 "Party A", 甲乙丙 "A, B, C", 甲等 "first class". It is used when naming parties in a contract or ranking. It is also the nail of a finger in 指甲 "fingernail".
column4: 甲队以二比一赢了乙队。
column5: 甲隊以二比一贏了乙隊。
column6: Jiǎ duì yǐ èr bǐ yī yíng le yǐ duì.
column7: Team A beat Team B by two to one.
column9: The first of the ten Heavenly Stems, used as "A" or "first": 甲方 "Party A", 甲乙丙 "A, B, C", 甲等 "first class". It is used when naming parties in a contract or ranking. It is also the nail of a finger in 指甲 "fingernail".

column3: The second of the ten Heavenly Stems, used as "B" or "second": 乙方 "Party B", 甲乙双方 "both parties", 乙级 "grade B". In contracts, 甲方 and 乙方 are the first and second party. It is also the name of a chemical group, in 乙醇 "ethanol".
column4: 乙队在下半场进了两个球。
column5: 乙隊在下半場進了兩個球。
column6: Yǐ duì zài xià bànchǎng jìn le liǎng ge qiú.
column7: Team B scored two goals in the second half.
column9: The second of the ten Heavenly Stems, used as "B" or "second": 乙方 "Party B", 甲乙雙方 "both parties", 乙級 "grade B". In contracts, 甲方 and 乙方 are the first and second party. It is also the name of a chemical group, in 乙醇 "ethanol".

column3: To cause or make something happen as a result: 这使得…, 使得大家更加努力 "makes everyone work harder". The cause comes first, and the result follows. It links a cause to a changed state, in written style. 使 "make" + 得 "result".
column4: 他的努力使得全家人过上了好日子。
column5: 他的努力使得全家人過上了好日子。
column6: Tā de nǔlì shǐde quánjiārén guòshàng le hǎo rìzi.
column7: His efforts made life better for the whole family.
column9: To cause or make something happen as a result: 這使得…, 使得大家更加努力 "makes everyone work harder". The cause comes first, and the result follows. It links a cause to a changed state, in written style. 使 "make" + 得 "result".

column3: To be able to, to be in a position to, thanks to circumstances: 得以实现 "be realized", 得以解决 "be solved", 得以进行. It always goes before a verb and does not have a person's effort as the focus. It is a formal word.
column4: 经过大家的努力，问题得以解决。
column5: 經過大家的努力，問題得以解決。
column6: Jīngguò dàjiā de nǔlì, wèntí déyǐ jiějué.
column7: Thanks to everyone's efforts, the problem was solved.
column9: To be able to, to be in a position to, thanks to circumstances: 得以實現 "be realized", 得以解決 "be solved", 得以進行. It always goes before a verb and does not have a person's effort as the focus. It is a formal word.

column3: To apply an action to something mentioned before, used before a two-syllable verb: 加以解释 "explain it", 加以改进 "improve it", 加以保护 "protect it". The word has no meaning alone; it makes the verb after it formal and shows that the object came before it. The verb must be more than one syllable.
column4: 对这个问题我们必须加以重视。
column5: 對這個問題我們必須加以重視。
column6: Duì zhège wèntí wǒmen bìxū jiāyǐ zhòngshì.
column7: We must pay attention to this problem.
column9: To apply an action to something mentioned before, used before a two-syllable verb: 加以解釋 "explain it", 加以改進 "improve it", 加以保護 "protect it". The word has no meaning alone; it makes the verb after it formal and shows that the object came before it. The verb must be more than one syllable.
